strings.{actor} 一嗓子把整个机舱都喊醒了。马红梅抱着箱子，脸色煞白。: {actor}'s shout wakes the whole cabin. Helen Ma clutches the suitcase, white as paper.
strings.{actor} 一把掀开了周建国的外套：牛肉干的包装袋和巧克力锡纸掉了一地。: {actor} yanks George Zhou's coat open: dried-beef wrappers and chocolate foil spill across the floor.
strings.{actor} 一页一页地念完了。: {actor} reads it out, page by page, to the last one.
strings.{actor} 什么也没说，把收音机塞进了自己的包里。: {actor} says nothing and slips the radio into {actor.his} bag.
strings.{actor} 做了个难看但管用的护目镜。: {actor} makes an ugly pair of goggles that actually work.
strings.{actor} 关掉收音机，说今天信号不好，什么也没听清。: {actor} switches off the radio and says the reception was bad today, {actor.he} couldn't make anything out.
strings.{actor} 半个身子掉了下去，被卡住了，腿撞在冰壁上。: {actor} goes in half-way, jams, legs smashing against the ice wall.
strings.{actor} 半夜咳醒，咳出来的痰里带着粉红色的泡沫，一躺平就喘不上气，嘴唇发: {actor} wakes at midnight coughing, pink froth in it, and cannot breathe lying flat, lips going blue. Someone who knows a little medicine listens to the gurgling in {actor.his} chest and goes pale: HAPE. At this altitude there is only one real cure, and it is downhill.
strings.{actor} 去坡上取干净的雪时，脚下的雪层突然塌下去一块——是一条暗裂缝，深: Fetching clean snow on the slope, {actor} feels the crust give way underfoot: a hidden crevasse, bottomless.
strings.{actor} 又一次爬上了山脊，缩在迎风面的岩石后面，等那个蓝点停下来。: {actor} climbs the ridge once more and crouches behind the windward rocks, waiting for the blue dot to stop moving.
strings.{actor} 和周建国达成了交易：一块巧克力换一个秘密。: {actor} strikes a deal with George Zhou: one chocolate bar for one secret.
strings.{actor} 和旁边的人聊起了出事之前的生活。: {actor} talks with the person beside {actor.him} about life before the crash.
strings.{actor} 和马红梅做了一笔交易：一把虫草，换一张闭上的嘴。: {actor} and Helen Ma strike a deal: a handful of caterpillar fungus for a closed mouth.
strings.{actor} 在一个旅行包里翻出一台半导体收音机，还有半格电。: In a duffel bag {actor} finds a transistor radio, with a little battery left in it.
strings.{actor} 在从机尾背回来的东西里发现了驾驶舱语音记录的打印单——是机组的飞: Among the things carried back from the tail, {actor} finds a printout from the cockpit voice recorder: the crew's flight log, its last pages recording an argument between the captain and the first officer.
strings.{actor} 在山脊上看见了：机尾卡在西南边一条沟里，离这里大概半天的路。: From the ridge {actor} sees it: the tail is wedged in a gully to the southwest, about half a day's walk from here.
strings.{actor} 在阿妈身边坐了很久，说了很多话。: {actor} sits a long while beside Amala and talks and talks.
strings.{actor} 帮马红梅挪那只铝合金箱子时，发现它沉得出奇。马红梅一把抢了回去，: Helping Helen Ma shift the aluminium case, {actor} finds it astonishingly heavy. Helen Ma snatches it back, smiling: "Just clothes."
strings.{actor} 想起了家里的人。: {actor} thinks about the people at home.
strings.{actor} 扑倒在雪里，大口喘着气。差一点。: {actor} drops face-first into the snow, gulping air. That close.
strings.{actor} 把一个本子还给了陈默。: {actor} hands a notebook back to Martin Chen.
strings.{actor} 把一块饼干塞进阿妈手心，攥着她的手，不让她推回来。: {actor} presses a biscuit into Amala's palm and holds her hand so she cannot push it back.
strings.{actor} 把听到的话一字一字地复述了一遍。机舱里安静得能听见风声。过了很久: {actor} repeats what {actor.he} heard, word for word. The cabin is so quiet you can hear the wind. After a long while Jay Jiang says: Then it is on us.
strings.{actor} 把塑料袋揣进了贴身的衣兜。杨机长点点头，像是交完了班。: {actor} puts the bag in an inside pocket. The captain nods, like a man who has just handed over his watch.
strings.{actor} 把大家一个个摇醒，说：不能再等了。: {actor} shakes everyone awake, one by one. We cannot wait any longer.
strings.{actor} 把字条上的话大声念了出来。马红梅的脸一阵红一阵白。: {actor} reads the note out loud. Helen Ma goes red, then white.
strings.{actor} 把字条揉成一团，塞进了口袋。: {actor} crumples the note into a ball and stuffs it into a pocket.
strings.{actor} 把字条还给了她。: {actor} gives the note back to her.
strings.{actor} 把手机塞回怀里，转身去化雪了。: {actor} slips the phone back inside {actor.his} jacket and goes to melt snow.
strings.{actor} 把手机揣回怀里焐着，只露出一个角对着天，数着秒等那个蓝点不再乱跳: {actor} keeps the phone inside {actor.his} jacket with one corner showing to the sky, counting seconds until the blue dot stops wandering.
strings.{actor} 把收音机揣进怀里，说每天整点听一次。: {actor} tucks the radio inside {actor.his} coat and says {actor.he} will listen on the hour, every hour.
strings.{actor} 把脸转向了舱壁。: {actor} turns {actor.his} face to the cabin wall.
strings.{actor} 把记录本塞进了火堆。: {actor} throws the logbook into the fire.
strings.{actor} 把记录本悄悄塞给了陈默。: {actor} quietly slips the logbook to Martin Chen.
strings.{actor} 把领头人拉到一边，低声说了几句。: {actor} takes the leader aside and murmurs a few words.
strings.{actor} 把飞行记录本合上，轻轻放回了原处。: {actor} closes the flight log and lays it gently back where it was.
strings.{actor} 抱着一串氧气面罩，吸完一个换一个。天亮的时候，嘴唇的颜色淡了一些: {actor} hugs a string of oxygen masks, draining one and reaching for the next. By dawn there is some colour back in {actor.his} lips.
strings.{actor} 揉了揉眼睛，继续干活。: {actor} rubs {actor.his} eyes and gets back to work.
strings.{actor} 撬开了箱子：一捆一捆的现金，还有几大包虫草。: {actor} pries the case open: bundles of cash, and big packets of caterpillar fungus.
strings.{actor} 擦了擦嘴，说没事。: {actor} wipes {actor.his} mouth and says it is nothing.
strings.{actor} 用围巾把脚裹了一层又一层。: {actor} wraps {actor.his} feet in scarf after scarf.
strings.{actor} 的脚趾已经发黑了，一股说不出的味道。林晓看了一眼，说再不处理会坏: {actor}'s toes have gone black, and smell like nothing else on earth. Sharon Lin takes one look and says it will turn to gangrene if it is not dealt with: better to cut the dead part away.
strings.{actor} 的话让机舱里更冷了。: What {actor} says makes the cabin colder still.
strings.{actor} 盯着箱子不放。: {actor} cannot take {actor.his} eyes off the case.
strings.{actor} 盯着舱顶看了很久，最后闭上了眼睛。: {actor} stares at the cabin ceiling for a long time, then closes {actor.his} eyes.
strings.{actor} 站到雪檐尽头，把手机举过头顶，大拇指一直按在“发送”上。: {actor} stands at the end of the cornice with the phone above {actor.his} head and {actor.his} thumb on Send.
strings.{actor} 给杨机长换垫在身下的座椅套时，飞行记录本从他胸口滑了下来，摊开在: As {actor} changes the seat covers under the captain, the flight log slides off his chest and falls open at that page. Continuing was the captain's decision. The signature is a shaky scrawl; on the witness line is Martin Chen's name, the ink still fresh.
strings.{actor} 翻了个身，假装睡着了。: {actor} rolls over and pretends to be asleep.
strings.{actor} 背对着风，一遍一遍地按着那三个数字。: {actor} turns {actor.his} back to the wind and dials the three digits again and again.
strings.{actor} 被抱上了直升机。: {actor} is carried aboard in someone's arms.
strings.{actor} 被救援队接下了山。: The rescue team brings {actor} down off the mountain.
strings.{actor} 裹着毯子躺了一会。: {actor} lies wrapped in a blanket for a while.
strings.{actor} 说了很多鼓劲的话。: {actor} says a lot of things to keep everyone going.
strings.{actor} 趴在原地，用尽力气喊。: {actor} stays flat in the snow and shouts with everything {actor.he} has.
strings.{actor} 跟着泽仁走上了垭口。: {actor} follows Tsering up towards the pass.
strings.{actor} 轻轻地唱起了一首儿歌。机舱里有几个人也跟着哼了起来。: {actor} softly starts singing a children's song. In the cabin, a few others hum along.
strings.{actor} 轻轻拉开舱门，没有回头。: {actor} eases the cabin door open and does not look back.
strings.{actor} 闭上眼，听着那细细的嚼东西的声音，一直到天亮。: {actor} closes {actor.his} eyes and listens to the small sound of chewing until dawn.
strings.{actor} 靠着舱壁坐了一夜，听着自己胸口里的水声。: {actor} sits against the cabin wall all night, listening to the water in {actor.his} own chest.
strings.{leader} 判江杰去探路。周建国骂了一句，摔门出去了。: {leader} sends Jay Jiang to scout. George Zhou swears and slams out.
strings.{leader} 判江杰留下化雪。江杰一脚踢翻了水桶。: {leader} keeps Jay Jiang back to melt snow. Jay Jiang kicks over the bucket.
strings.{leader} 说了算，输的一方会记恨: {leader} gets the final word, and the loser will hold it against {leader.him}
strings.{target} 把睡袋卷好绑在背上，朝东面的山脊走去。大家看着那个黑点越来越小: {target} rolls the sleeping bag, lashes it to {target.his} back and walks towards the eastern ridge. They watch the dark speck shrink, until it vanishes on the white slope.
strings.{target} 把裹着塑料袋的手机塞进最里面那层衣服，紧了紧鞋带：“明天天一亮: {target} tucks the bagged phone into {target.his} innermost layer and pulls {target.his} laces tight. "First light tomorrow."
strings.{target} 顶着风雪出去了，半个小时后才被拖回来，眉毛和睫毛上全是冰。: {target} goes out into the storm and is dragged back half an hour later, ice in {target.his} eyebrows and lashes.
strings.“晴空乱流，没有预警。”陈默说得很平静。周建国盯着他看了半天，哼了一声。: "Clear-air turbulence. No warning." Martin Chen says it calmly. George Zhou stares at him for a long moment and grunts.
strings.“高烧，谵妄。”陈默的声音很平静，“他在说三年前的一次备降。”: "High fever. Delirium." Martin Chen's voice is calm. "He is talking about a diversion, three years ago."
strings.……不怪你，小陈。拍板的，是我。: ...Not your fault, Martin. I made the call.
strings.一个人走，活下来的机会大得多；留下的人会怎么样，不去想了: Go alone and the chance of living is far better; what happens to the ones left behind, do not think about it
strings.一个大人敞开衣服，把她贴着胸口抱住，两个人一起裹进毯子里: One of the adults opens their clothes and holds her against their chest, and the two of them are wrapped in blankets together
strings.一个快死的人，会对你说实话吗？: Will a dying man tell you the truth?
strings.一件厚毛衣，当场就穿上了: A thick sweater, on someone's back before you could blink
strings.一动不动，大声喊人: Stay put and shout for help
strings.一包牦牛肉干: A packet of dried yak beef
strings.一块还不够塞牙缝，但谁也说不出什么: One piece does not even fill the gap in your teeth, but nobody can say a word against it
strings.一堆扭曲的金属，没什么用: A pile of twisted metal. Useless.
strings.一板阿莫西林胶囊: A blister pack of amoxicillin capsules
strings.上一次差点没回来: Last time, someone nearly did not come back
strings.上飞机前，把遇难者的名字刻在机身上: Before climbing aboard, carve the names of the dead into the fuselage
strings.下午，一架军绿色的运输机从山脊后面钻了出来，压得很低，在冰斗上空绕了两圈，机翼一: In the afternoon a drab green transport plane comes out from behind the ridge, very low, circles the cirque twice and rocks its wings, left, right. It means: we see you. On the third pass a bundle drops from its belly under an orange parachute. The wind pushes the canopy west, and it comes down halfway up the steep slope on the west side of the cirque.
strings.下山以后，林晓自己去找了医院的伦理委员会，把第一天那个没被抢救的男人的事说了。没: After they came down, Sharon Lin went to the hospital's ethics committee on her own and told them about the man nobody had treated on the first day. No one came after her for it. She moved out of the emergency room anyway, into intensive care, and said she wanted to stay with every patient there to the very end.
strings.下山以后，登山社的人都知道了他只爬过两座入门的山。江杰没解释。第二年冬天，他报了: After they came down, everyone in the mountaineering club knew he had only ever climbed two beginner peaks. Jay Jiang did not explain. The next winter he signed up for a proper glacier course and started from how to put on crampons.
strings.下山以后，马红梅给冰斗里活下来的每一个人都包了一个红包，没有一个人收。她的虫草生: After they came down, Helen Ma made up a red envelope for every survivor of the cirque, and not one of them took it. She went on trading caterpillar fungus; only the aluminium case never left her house again.
strings.下山路线会清楚很多，但别人会问：你怎么知道飞机在哪？: The way down would be much clearer, but then people ask: how do you know where the plane is?
strings.不会说话。高兴了摇尾巴，害怕了往人腿后面钻，冲着山脊叫的时候，耳朵竖得笔直。: He does not talk. Wags his tail when he is happy, hides behind your legs when he is frightened, and when he barks at the ridge, both ears stand straight up.
strings.不动她的东西，再拆几排座椅烧: Leave her things alone; tear out a few more rows of seats to burn
strings.不去拿了：飞机已经看见我们了，就等直升机: Leave it. The plane has seen us; wait for the helicopter
strings.不承认也不否认，大家会自己去想: Neither confirm nor deny. People will make up their own minds.
strings.不接：“您自己交给她。救援就快来了。”: Refuse it. "Give it to her yourself. Rescue is nearly here."
strings.不撬了，让他待在驾驶舱里，大家轮流去陪他: Stop trying to pull him free. Leave him in the cockpit, and everyone takes turns sitting with him.
strings.不替自己撒谎，也不当着一个快死的人认罪: You will not lie for yourself, and you will not confess to a dying man
strings.不止一个人看见了。: More than one person saw it.
strings.不用急救包，拿座椅骨架当夹板: No medkit: splint it with a seat frame
strings.不费东西，但隔这么远很难被看见: Costs nothing, but from that far away, who would ever see it
strings.东西被雪埋了就再也找不回来，但被埋的人等不了: Once the snow buries the supplies they are gone for good, but anyone buried alive cannot wait
strings.两个人一前一后，踩着泽仁来时的脚印，消失在垭口那边。: The two of them go one behind the other, following Tsering's tracks, and disappear over the pass.
strings.两个人互相照应，消息一定能带到；可营地里少了一个能干活的人: Two can watch out for each other and the message is sure to get there, but the camp is one pair of hands short
strings.两个人把江杰按在了地上。他挣扎了一会儿，最后哭了。: Two of them pin Jay Jiang to the ground. He struggles for a while, and then he cries.
strings.中午，东面的垭口上冒出了一串黑点。走在最前面的是泽仁，后面跟着乡里的干部、七八个: At noon a line of dark specks appears on the eastern pass. Tsering is in front, and behind him come township officials, seven or eight herders and rescue workers in orange. Yaks carry stretchers, oxygen bottles and quilts, plodding through waist-deep snow one step at a time.
strings.也许他真能做到: Maybe he really can pull it off
strings.也许能压住感染: It might hold the infection down
strings.事故调查报告写的是“遭遇未预报的强烈晴空乱流”。陈默恢复了飞行资格，却再也没飞过: The accident report read "encountered severe, unforecast clear-air turbulence". Martin Chen got his licence back, but he never flew a plateau route again. Every time dispatch asked whether the weather would hold, he looked at the radar one more time and said: divert.
strings.事故调查报告采信了机长签字的那一页。陈默恢复了飞行资格，又飞了很多年，从来没有晚: The accident report accepted the page the captain had signed. Martin Chen got his licence back and flew for many more years, and never once delayed a diversion. On the anniversary of Victor Yang's death he goes to the cemetery alone with a bottle of water and stands there until dark.
strings.二十三年。这条航线，我飞了二十三年。: Twenty-three years. I flew this route for twenty-three years.
strings.云压得很低，看不清山脊。: The cloud sits low, and the ridge is lost in it.
strings.五个人一串，踩着彼此的脚印往坡上挪。: Five on a line, they inch up the slope in each other's footprints.
strings.交给卓玛阿妈：让她解开藏袍，把孩子贴着胸口捂着: Give her to Amala Dolma: let her open her robe and hold the child against her skin
strings.人吃什么它吃什么，要活一起活: He eats what we eat. If we live, he lives.
strings.人多找得快；可每个人都要在零下二十度的夜里冻上一阵: More people find her faster; but every one of them will spend time out in a night below minus twenty
strings.人都这样了，追究还有什么用: Look at the state of him. What good would it do now
strings.什么也不消耗；驾驶舱里一天比一天冷: Costs nothing at all; and the cockpit grows colder every day
strings.什么也不说，过去握住机长的手: Say nothing, and go take the captain's hand.
strings.什么都不消耗，但伤口一直敞着: Costs nothing, but the wound stays open
strings.今天大家一起挖，先把狗笼子掏出来: Everyone digs together today. Get the dog crate out first.
strings.今晚可能还会这样: It could be like this again tonight
strings.今晚就会暖和很多: It will be a lot warmer tonight
strings.从机舱壁和座椅里拆出来的隔热材料，可以缝睡袋。: Insulation torn out of the cabin walls and seats. Enough to sew a sleeping bag.
strings.从机舱壁和座椅里拆出隔热棉（缝睡袋用），海绵也能烧。代价是机舱会漏风。: Strip insulation out of the cabin walls and seats (for the sleeping bag); the foam burns too. The price is a cabin that leaks wind.
strings.从此有了一页白纸黑字的证词；可那不是真的，你知道，他也知道: From now on there is a page in black and white; but it is not true, and you know it, and so does he
strings.从自己那份里掰一块，硬塞给阿妈: Break off a piece of your own share and push it into Amala's hand
strings.他们已经在找了，差的只是让他们看见: They are already searching; all that is missing is for them to see you
strings.他们把杨机长抬到舱外，垫上两层座椅套。他眯着眼看了很久的天，说：“能见度很好。今: They carry the captain outside and lay him on two layers of seat covers. He squints up at the sky for a long time. "Visibility's good. You could fly today."
strings.他们迟早会找过来，省点力气: They will find us sooner or later. Save your strength.
strings.他会恨拦他的人: He will hate whoever stopped him
strings.他出不来；可风挡上的雪扒干净了，他就能看见天: He cannot be moved; but with the snow cleared off the windscreen, he can see the sky
strings.他认得路；能不能把话说清楚，就看运气了: He knows the way; whether he can make himself understood is down to luck
strings.他走得快，三四天就能带人上来；可垭口的雪很深，话也不一定说得清: He travels fast: three or four days and he could bring people up. But the pass is deep in snow, and he may not be able to make himself understood
strings.以后的雪水都烧开再喝: Boil all the snow water from now on
strings.伤员和孩子先走: The injured and the child go first
strings.伤员被绑上担架，捆在牦牛背上。最后一个人离开机舱时，回头看了一眼。: The injured are strapped to stretchers and lashed onto yak backs. The last one to leave the cabin looks back once.
strings.你今晚能多吃一口: You eat a little more tonight
strings.你们的衣服，薄。（摸了摸别人的外套，直摇头）: Your clothes. Thin. (He feels someone's coat and shakes his head.)
strings.你会冷很多，他欠你一条命: You will be much colder, and he will owe you his life
strings.你吃饱一点，他欠你一个秘密: You get a little more to eat, and he owes you a secret
strings.你早晓得在哪儿，为啥子飞机还会撞山？: You knew where we were all along, so why the hell did the plane hit the mountain?
strings.你的箱子里装着 28 万现金和一批虫草，是你全部的身家。: Your case holds 280,000 in cash and a batch of caterpillar fungus. Everything you own.
strings.你说自己登过很多雪山，其实只跟登山社爬过两座五千米的入门山峰，从没在冬天的冰川上: You say you have climbed plenty of snow mountains. In truth you have only done two 5,000 m beginner peaks with the club, and you have never walked on a winter glacier.
strings.保住希望，但谎言迟早会被拆穿: Hope survives, but a lie comes apart sooner or later
strings.保住秘密，但以后被拆穿会更糟: The secret holds, but it will be worse if it comes out later
strings.保住秘密，活着回去: Keep the secret and get home alive
strings.保住秘密；可懂医的人看得出，他清醒得很: The secret holds; but anyone with medical sense can see he is perfectly lucid
strings.信写了满满两页。最后一句是杨机长自己的话：“考上了，就好好念。”那一页，陈默一直: The letter fills two pages. The last line is the captain's own words: "If you get in, study hard." The other page Martin Chen never touches.
strings.傍晚，东面的雪坡上走下来一个人：油亮的羊皮藏袍，脸被太阳晒得黑红，背上捆着一个牛: Towards evening a man comes down the eastern snow slope: a sheepskin Tibetan robe shiny with wear, a face burned dark red by the sun, a leather sack roped to his back. His name is Tsering, a herder from the far side of the mountain, up looking for stray yaks. He tips everything out of the sack: tsampa, butter, dried beef. Chinese, he knows a handful of words.
strings.傍晚，雪停了。夕阳把对面的雪峰染成了金色。有那么一会儿，谁都没有说话。: Towards evening the snow stops. The low sun turns the peaks opposite gold. For a while nobody speaks.
strings.充公，大家分着吃: Confiscate it and share it out
strings.先别动他，等救援: Leave him for now and wait for rescue
strings.先喂他喝一整天的糖水，明天再慢慢撬: Feed him sugar water for a full day, then start prying tomorrow
strings.先开机，让大家看看家里人的照片: Switch it on first, and let everyone see Zack's photos of home
strings.先把散落的行李和食物收拢起来: Gather up the scattered luggage and food first
strings.先把机身的断口堵上: Seal the breach in the fuselage first
strings.先把被埋的人挖出来: Dig out whoever is buried first
strings.先把遇难者抬出去，腾出地方: Carry the dead out first, to make room
strings.先抢救食物和燃料: Save the food and the fuel first
strings.先捂着，等下了山再说: Sit on it for now; deal with it once we are down
strings.先贴身捂着，等哪天晴天、风小了再上去: Keep them warm against your skin for now; go up on a clear day with less wind
strings.入冬前的最后一次搜索，空军的直升机在冰斗里找到了机身。机舱最里面只有一个人还活着: On the last search before winter closed in, an air force helicopter found the fuselage in the cirque. Only one person was still alive at the far end of the cabin: {survivors}. The others lay pressed together, as if asleep. For years afterwards people asked: why you, of all of them? {survivors} never once answered that question.
strings.公共的食物一点也不多；她和豆豆能多撑些日子: There is very little shared food to begin with; she and Dottie will last a few more days that way
strings.再上一次山脊，这回等定位刷新出来再发: Go up the ridge again, and this time wait for a fresh fix before sending
strings.再也不会闷着；可机舱漏风，夜里会更冷: No more smoke building up; but the cabin will leak wind, and the nights will be colder
strings.再派人上山脊，这回把坐标发对: Send someone up the ridge again, and get the coordinates right this time
strings.再等等，也许飞机会来: Wait a bit longer. Maybe a plane will come.
strings.写下真正发生的事：机长两次提出备降，是我坚持往前飞: Write what really happened: the captain twice proposed diverting, and I insisted on flying on
strings.冰斗三面是陡坡，坡上积着厚雪。下山的路要先翻过东面的山脊。: Steep walls on three sides of the cirque, deep snow on the slopes. The way down means crossing the eastern ridge first.
strings.冲动、好胜、受不了坐以待毙；说话不过脑子，但真到危险时肯往前冲。: Impulsive, competitive, cannot stand sitting still waiting to die; speaks without thinking, but when it turns dangerous he is the one who runs forward.
strings.冷静、有原则、不太会拒绝别人；累到极限也不肯先休息；看不惯自私的人。: Calm, principled, not very good at saying no; will not rest first even at the end of her strength; cannot stand selfish people.
strings.凌晨，山上传来闷雷一样的轰响——雪崩！积雪从断口灌进机舱，有人被埋住了，食物和燃: Before dawn a muffled boom rolls down the mountain: avalanche! Snow pours through the breach into the cabin; someone is buried, and food and fuel are scattered everywhere.
strings.凑过去小声说：分我一半，我就当没看见: Lean over and whisper: give me half and I saw nothing
strings.几个人喊着号子，一寸一寸地把仪表板撬了起来。: Several of them heave in rhythm and inch the instrument panel up.
strings.几个人把他抬到舱外，让他晒晒太阳: Have a few people carry him outside into the sun
strings.几个人硬把他们拉开了。两个人坐在机舱两头，谁也不看谁。: The others pull them apart by force. The two of them sit at opposite ends of the cabin, not looking at each other.
strings.几个人被拖到雪地上，裹着毯子大口喘气，脸上慢慢有了血色。: Several are dragged out onto the snow, wrapped in blankets, gulping air, colour slowly coming back to their faces.
strings.几双大手攥着雪，在她的小手上来回地搓。: Big hands full of snow scrub back and forth over her small ones.
strings.几块座椅海绵: A few blocks of seat foam
strings.几瓶冻住的矿泉水: A few bottles of frozen mineral water
strings.几箱茶砖和药材，吃不了也烧不了: Crates of brick tea and medicinal herbs: you cannot eat them or burn them
strings.几箱货物的木头包装: Wooden packing cases from the cargo
strings.分口粮的时候，豆豆把自己那半块饼干掰开，悄悄塞进了发着烧的小赵手里。小赵愣了一下: When the rations are handed out, Dottie breaks her half biscuit in two and quietly presses it into Zack's hand; he is burning with fever. He stares at her, and his eyes go red.
strings.别在我身上浪费药了，留给孩子。: Do not waste medicine on me. Save it for the child.
strings.制服外面只套了件薄外套。坠机时撞伤了头，但他是唯一知道飞机大概掉在哪里的人。: Nothing over his uniform but a thin jacket. He took a blow to the head in the crash, but he is the only one who knows roughly where the plane went down.
strings.包裹里是四箱单兵口粮、一捆军用棉被、两个急救包、一盒头孢、几块固体燃料，还有一张: Inside: four cases of field rations, a bale of army quilts, two first-aid kits, a box of cephalosporin, a few blocks of solid fuel, and a laminated note. Coordinates received. Helicopter waiting on a weather window. Hold on.
strings.十一月中旬，一架从康定飞往成都的支线客机在大雪山上空遭遇强烈乱流，撞上山脊后滑进: In mid-November a regional airliner bound from Kangding to Chengdu ran into violent turbulence over the Daxueshan range, struck a ridge and slid into a cirque. The tail broke off on impact, and no one knows where it came down.
strings.半坐着，多喝水，什么活也别干: Sit him half upright, plenty of water, no work at all
strings.半夜，{actor} 听见周建国那边窸窸窣窣的，像是在嚼什么东西。: In the middle of the night {actor} hears a rustling from George Zhou's corner, like someone chewing.
strings.半夜，{actor} 被一股说不清的味道弄醒——有点像晒干的蘑菇，又有点腥。马红: In the small hours a smell wakes {actor}: something like dried mushrooms, faintly fishy. Helen Ma is curled against her suitcase with her back to everyone, putting something into her mouth piece by piece and chewing slowly. In the snow-light from the porthole {actor} sees what it is: caterpillar fungus, golden stalks half a finger long.
strings.卓玛阿妈从藏袍里掏出一个油亮的小皮口袋：里面是糌粑，还有一坨用塑料袋包着的酥油。: Amala Dolma takes a small, shiny leather pouch from inside her robe: tsampa, and a lump of butter wrapped in plastic. She gestures: Tsampa, everybody eat. This butter is going to Lhasa, to light lamps for the Buddha at the Jokhang.
strings.卓玛阿妈叹了口气，把那一小块糌粑放进了自己嘴里。: Amala Dolma sighs, and puts the little piece of tsampa into her own mouth.
strings.卓玛阿妈已经两天没碰自己那份口粮了，分到的那一小块，全都悄悄塞进了豆豆手里。她自: Amala Dolma has not touched her own ration for two days; every small piece that comes to her goes quietly into Dottie's hands. She drinks only snow water and prays, over and over, her hands like ice.
strings.卓玛阿妈开始咳嗽、发烧，痰里带着锈色。一直躺着不能动的老人，最怕的就是坠积性肺炎: Amala Dolma starts coughing and running a fever, rust-coloured phlegm in it. For an old person who cannot move from lying down, the thing to fear is hypostatic pneumonia.
strings.卓玛阿妈愣了一下，把口袋推回来，又被推回去。推了三回她才收下，每天捏一小团塞给豆: Amala Dolma hesitates, pushes the pouch back, and it is pushed back to her. Three times, before she keeps it, and every day she pinches off a little and gives it to Dottie.
strings.卓玛阿妈把酥油递过来的时候，手停了一下。她闭上眼睛，念了很长一段经。: As Amala Dolma holds out the butter, her hand stops. She closes her eyes and prays a long, long prayer.
strings.卓玛阿妈拉着泽仁的袖子，用藏话把几个人、几个伤员、飞机在哪个冰斗，一句一句交代清: Amala Dolma holds Tsering's sleeve and, in Tibetan, spells it out to him line by line: how many people, how many wounded, which cirque the plane is in.
strings.卓玛阿妈是在一个早上走的，羊皮袍还敞着，像是刚刚把谁抱在怀里。豆豆后来问了很多次: Amala Dolma died one morning with her sheepskin robe still open, as if she had only just been holding someone. Dottie asked many times afterwards: was it because she held me that she got so cold? Nobody answered her.
strings.卓玛阿妈的胯骨好了以后，一瘸一拐地还是去了拉萨。她在大昭寺门口点了一盏灯，说是替: When her hip had healed, Amala Dolma limped her way to Lhasa after all. At the Jokhang she lit a lamp, for a little Han girl, she said, who had once slept a night inside her robe.
strings.卓玛阿妈解开羊皮袍，把豆豆整个儿裹进怀里，脸贴着脸，嘴里一直念着经。天快亮的时候: Amala Dolma opens her sheepskin robe and wraps Dottie up whole inside it, cheek to cheek, murmuring prayers all the while. Towards dawn the colour creeps back into Dottie's fingers and she starts to cry with the pain of it. Pain means alive.
strings.卓玛阿妈走的那天夜里，手里还攥着念珠。活下来的人把念珠带下了山，托人送回了塔公。: On the night Amala Dolma died, her hand was still closed around her prayer beads. The survivors carried the beads down the mountain and had them sent back to Tagong. Her son went to Lhasa in her place, and lit a lamp at the Jokhang for every one of them on the mountain.
strings.原型：1972 年乌拉圭空军 571 号班机坠毁于安第斯山脉。45 人中 16: Based on: in 1972 a Uruguayan Air Force plane, Flight 571, went down in the Andes. Of the 45 aboard, 16 held on up there for 72 days; two survivors finally walked out after ten days and met a herder, who rode ten hours to raise the alarm. The radio bulletin calling off the search, the battery found in the tail, the sleeping bag sewn from insulation: all come from that real event. So does the co-pilot, trapped in the crushed cockpit, who lasted the night before he died.
strings.去成都看刚出生的外孙。身板结实，手很巧，脾气又倔又急。坠机时左臂骨折。: Was on his way to Chengdu to see his newborn grandson. Sturdy, good with his hands, stubborn and quick-tempered. Broke his left arm in the crash.
strings.去拉萨朝佛的藏族老人: An elderly Tibetan on her way to Lhasa to pray
strings.去西南边的沟里找机尾：那里可能有食物、药、毯子，还有定位发射器的电池。要在机尾里: Head for the tail in the gully to the southwest: there may be food, medicine, blankets, and the battery for the locator beacon. You will spend a night out there and come back the next day.
strings.去远一点的坡上取干净的雪: Walk further up the slope for clean snow
strings.又一个睡不着的夜。有人小声说：“也许我们根本等不到了。”: Another sleepless night. Someone says quietly: "Maybe they are never coming."
strings.又是一整天的风口和缺氧；电只够再试一两次: Another whole day of wind and thin air; there is charge for one or two more tries at most
strings.取水的人要多走很多路: Whoever fetches water walks a lot further
strings.取水：晴天靠阳光在铝板上化雪，阴雪天只能烧燃料；实在没有，人会直接吃雪（降低体温: Water: on a clear day, spread snow on aluminium sheets and let the sun melt it; under cloud or snow you have to burn fuel; with neither, people eat snow (it lowers body temperature and burns calories).
strings.只吃糌粑，酥油给她留着: Eat only the tsampa; keep the butter for her
strings.只替他给女儿写信；那一页，不写: Write only the letter to his daughter; leave the other page blank
strings.只能让她自己扛过去: She will have to ride it out on her own
strings.叫醒大家：明天一早就推选一个人带着睡袋下山: Wake everyone: at first light tomorrow they pick one person to take the sleeping bag and go down
strings.叫醒所有人：她箱子里还有吃的: Wake everyone: there is food in her suitcase
strings.可能会雪盲几天: It could leave you snow-blind for days
strings.可能救他一命，也可能直接要了他的命: It might save his life, or it might kill him outright
strings.可能有人会冻伤甚至失温: Someone could get frostbite, or worse, hypothermia
strings.可能还会有人病倒: Someone else may go down sick
strings.右小腿开放性骨折，骨头戳破了皮肤。很能忍，疼得厉害也只是咬着牙。: An open fracture of the right lower leg; the bone has broken through the skin. He endures it: even in real pain he only grits his teeth.
strings.吃的已经断了。黄豆瘦得肋骨一根根支棱着，夜里还是蜷在豆豆脚边给她暖脚。有人盯着它: The food is gone. Bean is so thin his ribs stand out one by one, and at night he still curls up at Dottie's feet to keep them warm. Someone stares at him for a long time, and finally says it out loud: there are still six or seven kilos of meat on him.
strings.吃，吃。糌粑捏紧一点，顶饿。: Eat, eat. Pack the tsampa tight. It stays with you.
strings.合上箱子，什么也不做: Close the suitcase and do nothing
strings.后半夜，{actor} 睁着眼睛躺着。缝好的睡袋卷就靠在舱门边，装吃的那只箱子就: In the small hours {actor} lies awake. The finished sleeping bag is rolled up against the cabin door, and the food crate is right there under {actor.his} feet. Everyone else is asleep; only the wind is knocking on the fuselage.
strings.后半夜，{name.chen} 冻得牙齿直打颤，蜷在机舱最冷的角落——他只穿了一: In the small hours {name.chen} is curled in the coldest corner of the cabin, teeth chattering. All he has is a uniform and a thin jacket. Helen Ma's mink coat is thick and warm.
strings.后半夜，有人摸了摸身边——豆豆的位置是空的，被窝里还有一点温度。舱门开着一条缝，: In the small hours someone reaches out in the dark: Dottie's place is empty, the blankets still faintly warm. The cabin door is open a crack. Outside it is below minus twenty and the wind is driving the snow sideways. A line of small footprints leads off towards the row of the dead, filling in with snow as they look.
strings.后半夜，杨机长发着高烧说起了胡话，忽然在黑暗里喊：“小陈！前面是雷暴……我说了备: In the small hours the captain, burning with fever, starts talking nonsense, and suddenly shouts out of the dark: "Martin! Thunderstorms ahead... I said divert, you had to push through!" More than one person in the cabin is awake.
strings.后来有记者问泽仁，那个老板娘塞给他的钱，他为什么不要。泽仁想了很久，说：山上，钱: A journalist later asked Tsering why he would not take the money the businesswoman pushed on him. Tsering thought for a long time. Up there, he said, money does not even burn well.
strings.听这风声，后半夜要起大风。断口再堵严实点。: Listen to that wind. It will get up after midnight. Plug that breach tighter.
strings.吵了整整一个上午。最后有人摔门出去，在雪地里站了很久。: They argued the whole morning. In the end someone slammed out and stood a long time in the snow.
strings.告诉大家，自己带路去探: Tell everyone, and lead the way out yourself to scout
strings.告诉她妈妈睡着了，别去吵她: Tell her that her mother is asleep, and not to disturb her
strings.周建国下山后第三个月，揣着一沓现金去了马红梅在成都的干货铺。钱拍在柜台上，他说：: Three months after coming down, George Zhou walked into Helen Ma's dried-goods shop in Chengdu with a wad of cash. He slapped it on the counter: the money for the fungus, every fen of it, count it. She did not count it. She made him stay for dinner. Between them they drank a bottle of baijiu, and neither of them mentioned the mountain.
strings.周建国和江杰为了谁去探路吵了起来。江杰说他是登山社的，周建国冷笑：“你爬过几座雪: George Zhou and Jay Jiang start fighting over who goes to scout. Jay Jiang says he is in the mountaineering club; George Zhou gives a cold laugh: "How many snow mountains have you climbed?" It gets uglier from there, and George Zhou grabs Jay Jiang by the collar with his good hand.
strings.周建国当着所有人的面问陈默：“你给老子说清楚，飞机到底是咋个掉下来的？”所有人都: In front of everyone, George Zhou asks Martin Chen: "You tell me straight. How the hell did this plane come down?" Everyone is watching him.
strings.周建国把那个塑料袋在怀里揣了一路。见到杨机长女儿的时候，他憋了半天，只说出一句：: George Zhou carried the plastic bag inside his coat the whole way down. When he met the captain's daughter he struggled for a long time and managed only: your father was a real man. Then he turned and left, and stood in the stairwell for a long while.
strings.周建国摊开手：早吃完了，就剩这些包装纸。: George Zhou spreads his hands: Finished it days ago. This is all that is left, the wrappers.
strings.周建国没能见到外孙。女儿在他外套的内兜里找到一张打印的照片，是外孙出生那天拍的，: George Zhou never saw his grandson. In the inside pocket of his coat his daughter found a printed photograph taken the day the baby was born, and on the back, in ballpoint: 3,200 grams. Looks like me.
strings.周建国见到外孙的时候，左臂还吊着绷带，只能用一只手抱。他把从机身上拆下来的一块铝: When George Zhou finally saw his grandson, his left arm was still in a sling and he could hold the boy one-handed only. He had brought home a strip of aluminium torn off the fuselage and nailed it to his balcony to hang cured meat on. If anyone asked, he said: That is my life, that is.
strings.和身边的人聊聊天: Talk with the people around you
strings.咬着皮带，让林晓动手: Bite down on the belt and let Sharon Lin work
strings.嗡嘛呢叭咪吽……嗡嘛呢叭咪吽……: Om mani padme hum... Om mani padme hum...
strings.四川口音的普通话，说话像在驾驶舱里报读数，一句是一句。: Mandarin with a Sichuan accent. He talks the way he called out readings in the cockpit: one clipped line at a time.
strings.固执、务实、看不起只会动嘴的人；护短，认定的人会拼命护着；不信任机组和“读书人”: Stubborn, practical, despises people who only talk; fiercely protective of his own, and would fight for anyone he has decided to trust; does not trust the crew, or "educated types".
strings.土办法，谁都听说过: An old remedy everybody has heard of
strings.在机舱和周围的雪里翻找散落的行李：吃的、喝的、能烧的、能穿的。越往后能找到的越少: Search the cabin and the snow around it for scattered luggage: food, drink, anything burnable, anything wearable. There is less to find every time.
strings.在机舱顶上撬一道通风缝，以后一直留着: Pry open a vent in the cabin roof and leave it open from now on
strings.在甘孜参加了三个月的医疗援助，正在回成都的路上。冷静、手稳，坠机后一直在照顾伤员: Had spent three months on a medical aid posting in Garze and was on her way back to Chengdu. Calm, steady-handed, and she has been looking after the injured since the crash.
strings.在这种地方受伤可不是小事: Getting hurt out here is no small thing
strings.在雪地里翻了一上午，捡回来一些东西。: A morning of digging in the snow, and a few things to show for it.
strings.在高原航线上飞了二十三年的老机长。驾驶舱被压扁的时候，他的两条腿卡在了变形的仪表: A veteran captain who flew plateau routes for twenty-three years. When the cockpit was crushed, both his legs were pinned under the buckled instrument panel. He is fully conscious. He just cannot get out.
strings.坏疽会感染，可能要命: Gangrene spreads, and it can kill
strings.坐到她身边，劝她为了孩子也得吃: Sit down beside her and tell her she has to eat, for the child's sake
strings.坐标准，信号也最好——前提是那片雪檐撑得住你: Accurate coordinates and the best signal, provided the cornice holds your weight
strings.坠机前，机长两次提出返航备降，是你坚持说天气能过去，继续往前飞。: Before the crash the captain twice suggested turning back or diverting. You insisted the weather would clear, and pushed on.
strings.坠机后的第一个早晨。机舱里横七竖八地躺着遇难者，风从断口灌进来。今天先做什么？: The first morning after the crash. The dead lie where they fell in the cabin, and wind pours in through the breach. What comes first today?
strings.坠机那天，你从空乘的餐车里偷偷揣走了一袋牛肉干和两块巧克力（约 900 千卡），: On the day of the crash you slipped a bag of dried beef and two chocolate bars (about 900 kcal) out of the galley cart and never handed them over.
strings.坡上积雪越厚越危险。: The deeper the snow lies on the slope, the more dangerous it is.
strings.垭口那边，雪，这么深。（比着自己的腰）: Over the pass, snow, this deep. (He measures against his waist.)
strings.外孙满月那天，周建国喝多了，当着一桌亲戚说起雪山上那袋牛肉干，说着说着就哭了。后: At his grandson's full-month dinner George Zhou drank too much, and in front of a table of relatives he told them about that bag of dried beef on the mountain, and started crying halfway through. Later, when the boy could walk, he would hold up a piece of dried beef and try to push it into his grandfather's mouth. George Zhou only waved it away.
strings.外界搜救的投入程度，会随时间减弱。: How much effort the outside world puts into the search. It fades with time.
strings.外面零下十几度，他也许撑不过今天；可这是他最后想要的: It is well below zero out there and he may not last the day; but it is the last thing he wants
strings.外面零下十几度，大人孩子都要冻一阵；可孩子需要好好告个别: It is well below zero out there, and adult and child will both get cold; but a child needs to say goodbye
strings.多一个壮劳力，他也要吃喝；报信会晚两天: One more strong back, but he eats and drinks too, and the message arrives two days later
strings.多一张嘴——就让它在下面吧: One more mouth to feed. Leave him down there.
strings.多一张嘴分口粮；可这是豆豆唯一的家人了: One more mouth against the rations; but he is the only family Dottie has left
strings.夜里落了一层新雪，包裹被埋住了大半。刨了一上午，只刨出来一半。: Fresh snow fell in the night and buried most of the bundle. A morning of digging recovers half of it.
strings.夜里走出机舱，失温: Walked out of the cabin at night; hypothermia
strings.夜里趁她睡着偷偷撬开看: Pry it open quietly at night while she is asleep
strings.夜里，陈默借着打火机的光把航图摊在膝盖上。按坠机前最后的位置推算，冰斗东边的山脊: At night Martin Chen spreads the chart on his knees by the light of a lighter. Working back from their last position before the crash, there should be a herders' track below the ridge east of the cirque.
strings.大人们也各匀一点给小赵: The adults each give a little of theirs to Zack
strings.大人们抽签，谁也别争，三个人先走: The adults draw lots. Nobody argues, and three of them go first
strings.大人牵着豆豆，在那一排人前面蹲了很久。豆豆把粉色的围巾解下来，仔仔细细地围在妈妈: A grown-up holds Dottie's hand and they crouch in front of the row for a long time. Dottie unwinds her pink scarf and wraps it carefully round her mother's neck. "Mum, I'll be good."
strings.大家决定了：明天早上选人。: They have decided: tomorrow morning, they choose who goes.
strings.大家又拆了几排座椅。马红梅悄悄往每个人手里塞了一块糖。: They tear out a few more rows of seats. Helen Ma quietly presses a sweet into everyone's hand.
strings.大家在坡上插了根木棍：只在那里取雪。: They plant a stick on the slope: snow is taken from there and nowhere else.
strings.大家在驾驶舱门口挂了一条毯子，轮流进去陪他说话。: They hang a blanket over the cockpit doorway and take turns going in to talk to him.
strings.大家把最暖和的位置让给了她。: They give her the warmest place.
strings.大家把能说的又说了一遍，泽仁拍了拍胸口。: They say everything they can say again, and Tsering pats his chest.
strings.大家把那部手机传到了能爬山的人手里。: The phone is passed into the hands of whoever can still climb.
strings.大家把雪水烧温，掺上糖，一口一口喂他喝了一整天。: They warm snow water, mix in sugar, and spoon it into him all day long.
strings.大家有权知道真相，但士气会崩: They have a right to know the truth, but morale will collapse
strings.大家比划着把能说的都说了。泽仁点着头，用藏话重复了好几遍。: They gesture out everything they can. Tsering nods, and repeats it several times in Tibetan.
strings.大家沉默着把遇难者一个一个抬到外面的雪地上。机舱空出来了，没人说话。: In silence they carry the dead out onto the snow, one by one. The cabin is emptier now, and nobody speaks.
strings.大家用火柴棍抽了签。抽到长签的人愣了一下，才被拽上了飞机。: They draw matchsticks. The one who draws the long one freezes for a moment, and then is pulled aboard.
strings.大家轮流趴在雪坑里，用手和饭盒挖了一整天。笼门一打开，一条瘦得脱了相的黄狗扑进了: They take turns lying in the snow pit, digging with bare hands and a food tin for a whole day. When the crate door opens, a yellow dog, thin to the bone, throws itself into Dottie's arms.
strings.大家轮流陪着他说话。小赵断断续续地讲了很多他老家的事。: They take turns sitting with him. Zack talks, in fits and starts, about his hometown.
strings.大家都想知道外面在不在找我们: Everyone wants to know whether anyone out there is still looking
strings.大约 2200 千卡；一张纸条在这儿不值什么，下了山就值了: About 2,200 kcal; a slip of paper is worth nothing up here, and a great deal down below
strings.大约 2200 千卡；马红梅会恨每一个投赞成票的人: About 2,200 kcal; Helen Ma will hate everyone who votes for it
strings.天亮以后，他们在那一排人的尽头找到了她。: At first light they find her at the end of the row.
strings.天亮以后，大家才发现：睡袋没了，箱底空了，{actor} 也不见了。: When it gets light they find out: the sleeping bag is gone, the food crate is empty, and {actor} is gone too.
strings.天亮的时候，好几个人头疼得像要裂开，恶心想吐，有一个怎么叫都叫不醒。机舱封得太严: By morning several of them have a splitting headache and are sick to their stomachs, and one of them will not wake no matter how hard they shake him. The cabin was sealed too tight and the fire smouldered all night: carbon monoxide.
strings.天刚亮，{actor} 揣着手机出发了。爬上东面山脊已经是中午：四千五百多米，风: {actor} sets off at first light with the phone inside {actor.his} clothes. It is noon before {actor.he} reaches the east ridge: over 4,500 metres, a wind {actor.he} can hardly stand in, ten steps and then a long stop to breathe. When the phone comes on, No Service flickers twice and one bar appears. Gone. Back again. On the lee side of the ridge the snow juts out over empty air, like the eaves of a roof.
strings.天很蓝，雪地反光刺眼，夜里会格外冷。: The sky is deep blue, the snow glare is blinding, and the nights are especially cold.
strings.天气窗口终于打开，空军的高原直升机做了入冬前的最后一次搜索，在冰斗里发现了机身。: The weather window finally opened. An air force plateau helicopter flew the last search before winter closed in, and found the fuselage in the cirque. Taken out alive: {survivors}. Those who did not live to see the day: {dead}.
strings.天这么黑，出去也是白搭，等天亮再找: It is pitch dark, going out is pointless. Search at first light
strings.她会一天天虚弱下去，豆豆能多吃一口: She will grow weaker day by day, and Dottie gets one more mouthful
strings.她会多吃 500 千卡，别人可能会发现: She eats 500 kcal more, and someone may notice
strings.她会记恨你: She will hold it against you
strings.她妈妈坐在她旁边，没能活下来。穿着一件粉色的羽绒服，总是攥着林晓的衣角。: Her mother was sitting beside her and did not survive. She wears a pink down jacket, and never lets go of the hem of Sharon Lin's coat.
strings.她现在不会哭；可小孩子会自己去找: She will not cry now; but children go looking on their own
strings.她自己能多撑些日子；别人饿着肚子看她嚼: She can last longer on her own; the rest go hungry and watch her chew
strings.她迟早要知道: She will find out sooner or later
strings.好得快，可外面是零下二十度: He heals faster, but it is -20°C outside
strings.妈妈说坐飞机能看见云朵，我还没看够呢。: Mama said you can see clouds from the plane. I have not looked enough yet.
strings.孩子和伤员最扛不住饿: The child and the injured take hunger worst
strings.孩子能先离开这里；他背着人，会走得慢: The child gets out of here first; carrying a man on his back, he will move slowly
strings.孩子能先走；他背着人，路上会慢，也更险: The child goes first; carrying a man on his back he will be slower on the way, and it is more dangerous
strings.孩子饿坏了谁也担不起: Nobody can answer for it if the child starves
strings.孩子，过来，钻到阿妈袍子里，暖和。: Child, come. Get inside Amala's robe. Warm.
strings.安静、知足，信佛，凡事先想着别人；不怕冷，也不太怕死，只怕给人添麻烦。手巧，缝了: Quiet, content, devout; thinks of others first in everything. Not afraid of the cold, not much afraid of dying, only of being a burden. Clever with her hands: a lifetime of sewing sheepskin robes.
strings.定位发射器上的小灯开始一闪一闪。没人知道外面能不能收到，但所有人都盯着它看了很久: The little light on the locator beacon starts to blink. No one knows whether anyone out there can hear it, but everyone watches it for a long time.
strings.定位终于不跳了。{actor} 一步一步往雪檐外面挪，每一步都先用脚跟试一试。: The fix finally settles. {actor} edges out along the cornice one step at a time, testing each step with a heel first.
strings.家在塔公草原。儿子给她买了机票，要从成都转机去拉萨，到大昭寺磕头。穿着一件厚厚的: Home is on the Tagong grasslands. Her son bought her the ticket: Chengdu, then a connection to Lhasa, to bow at the Jokhang. She wears a thick sheepskin robe; she broke her hip in the crash and cannot stand, yet at four thousand metres she shows not a trace of altitude sickness.
strings.小赵咬着一条皮带，惨叫声在机舱里回荡了很久。腿接上了，用夹板固定好了。: Zack bites down on a belt, and his screams echo around the cabin for a long time. The leg is set, and splinted.
strings.小赵哆嗦着从冲锋衣内兜里摸出一部手机和一个砖头大的充电宝。跑快递的人最怕没电，这: Shivering, Zack works a phone and a brick of a power bank out of the inside pocket of his jacket. A courier's worst fear is a dead battery, and for days he has kept them pressed against his stomach; the screen actually lights up. In the corner: No Service. "The cirque is walled in on every side," he says, short of breath. "Up on the east ridge there might be one bar."
strings.小赵把手机和充电宝用塑料袋包了两层，递了过来：“贴身揣着。冻透了，它就开不了机了: Zack wraps the phone and the power bank in two layers of plastic and holds them out. "Keep them against your skin. If they freeze through, they won't switch on."
strings.小赵把饼干塞回豆豆手里：“哥哥不饿。”: Zack pushes the biscuit back into Dottie's hand: "Big brother is not hungry."
strings.小赵没能下山。快递站的同事替他把车上剩下的二十几个件送完了，每个件上都贴了一张便: Zack did not come down off the mountain. His colleagues at the courier depot delivered the twenty-odd parcels still on his van, each one with a note stuck to it: Sorry. Late.
strings.小赵没说什么，只是把脸转向了舱壁。: Zack says nothing, and turns his face to the cabin wall.
strings.小赵的腿保住了，阴天会疼，走路有点跛。他又干回了快递，跑的是康定城里最陡的那几条: They saved Zack's leg. It aches when the weather turns, and he walks with a limp. He went back to courier work, on the steepest streets in Kangding. Every year on that day he posts a photograph of the snow mountains, without a single word.
strings.小赵的腿已经发黑发臭，烧到神志不清。林晓说：再不截肢，他会死于败血症。可这里没有: Zack's leg has gone black and foul, and the fever has taken his mind. Sharon Lin says: without amputation he will die of sepsis. But there is no anaesthetic here. All they have is Jay Jiang's knife.
strings.小赵翻出他妈在菜地里的照片、站点同事过生日的照片……手机传了一圈回来，电量从百分: Zack finds a photo of his mother in her vegetable patch, a birthday at the depot... The phone goes round the cabin and comes back with the battery fallen from 41 per cent to 9.
strings.小赵腿上的伤口露出了骨头茬。林晓说必须复位、固定，不然很快会感染。复位要两个人按: The wound on Zack's leg shows bare bone. Sharon Lin says it has to be set and splinted, or infection will follow fast. Setting it takes two people holding him down, it will hurt badly, and it costs one unit of medical supplies.
strings.小赵装上了假肢，跑不了快递了。他在康定开了个修电动车的小铺子，门口贴着一张手写的: Zack got a prosthetic leg, and could not run parcels any more. He opened a little electric-scooter repair shop in Kangding, with a handwritten notice on the door: Anyone from the mountain, repairs free. So far, nobody has come.
strings.小赵那部手机一直没修，屏幕裂着，电量停在百分之一，就摆在他床头。有人问起，他就说: Zack never had the phone repaired. The screen is still cracked, the battery stopped at one per cent, and it sits by his bed. When anyone asks, he says: that was the most important parcel I ever delivered.
strings.小赵那部手机和充电宝剩下的电。锂电池怕冷，冻透了就开不了机。: What is left in Zack's phone and power bank. Lithium batteries hate the cold; frozen through, they will not switch on.
strings.小陈呢？让小陈过来……算了，让他歇着。: Where is Martin? Tell Martin to come here... never mind. Let him rest.
strings.少一张嘴；它也许能把人引上来，也许就这么没了: One mouth less; he might lead people up to us, or he might simply be lost
strings.少冻坏几个人；可一个人在黑夜里找，要找很久: Fewer people frozen; but one person searching in the dark takes a long time
strings.屏幕上，那条短信下面跳出了两个小字：已送达。: Under the message on the screen, two small words appear: Delivered.
strings.屏幕上，那条短信下面跳出了两个小字：已送达。{actor} 蹲在雪里，半天站不起: Under the message on the screen, two small words appear: Delivered. {actor} crouches in the snow and for a long while cannot stand up.
strings.山脊上风大、缺氧，背风那面挑着雪檐；可只要发出去一条短信……: The ridge is windy and short of air, with cornices on the lee side; but if one text message gets out...
strings.山那边沟里的牦牛牧民。家里的牛都赶到冬季牧场了，还有三头走散在高山上，他上来找，: A yak herder from the valley on the far side of the mountain. His herd is already down at the winter pasture; three strays are still up high, and while he was looking for them he saw movement over here from a distance. He carries a leather sack, and knows only a few words of Chinese.
strings.山那边的牧民: A herder from the far side of the mountain
strings.川普，说话冲，爱说“老子”“莫得事”。: Sichuan-accented Mandarin, blunt to the point of rudeness, fond of "your old man" and "it is nothing".
strings.川西大雪山某冰斗: A cirque in the Daxueshan range, western Sichuan
strings.巧克力又被放回了箱子里。那天夜里，好几个人都没睡着。: The chocolate goes back into the crate. That night, several of them lie awake.
strings.巧克力给了最壮的那个人。没分到的人把脸转了过去。: The chocolate goes to the strongest of them. Those who got none turn their faces away.
strings.已经探明的下山路线。: The descent route, as far as it has been scouted.
strings.带她出去，让她跟妈妈好好说说话，把围巾给妈妈围上: Take her out to talk to her mother properly, and put the scarf on her
strings.带着那只箱子活着离开: Get out alive with that case
strings.年轻人的口气，爱说“兄弟”“我觉得吧”，急了会骂人。: The way young men talk: "bro", "the way I see it", and swearing when he is pushed.
strings.康巴口音，汉话一个词一个词往外蹦，说完一句就笑。: A Kham accent; he fires Chinese out one word at a time, and grins when he has got a sentence out.
strings.开一会儿舱门就行，别把热气全放跑: Just open the door for a moment; do not let all the heat out
strings.当众念出来: Read it out in front of everyone
strings.当众让她难堪: Humiliate her in front of everyone
strings.很疼，但能保住命: It will hurt, but it saves his life
strings.很难受，但机舱里能多挤下人，挤在一起才暖和: It is miserable, but more people fit in the cabin, and crowding together is what keeps you warm
strings.怕生、安静、会突然大哭。: Shy of strangers, quiet, and given to sudden fits of crying.
strings.您留着，自己和孩子慢慢吃: Keep it. Eat it slowly, you and the child.
strings.想想家里的人: Think about the people at home
strings.憨厚、话少、胆大；敬山。信得过的人就掏心掏肺；被人算计了也不吭声，转身就走。: Simple and good-natured, sparing with words, brave; he reveres the mountains. Once he trusts you he gives you everything; if someone plays him false he says nothing, and walks away.
strings.我不冷。真的不冷。: I am not cold. Really, I am not cold.
strings.我女儿今年高三。她说考上了，要请我吃火锅。: My daughter is in her last year of high school. She says if she gets in, she is treating me to hotpot.
strings.我数到一百，飞机就来了。一、二、三……: I will count to a hundred and the plane will come. One, two, three...
strings.我走，乡里，打电话。三天，四天，人来。: I go, township, telephone. Three days, four days, people come.
strings.所有人在雪地上又跳又喊。: Everyone jumps and shouts on the snow.
strings.所有人跑到雪地上挥衣服: Everyone runs out onto the snow, waving clothes
strings.所有人跪在雪里用手刨。被埋的人一个个被拖了出来，有人脸已经发紫。: Everyone kneels in the snow digging with bare hands. The buried are dragged out one by one; one of them is already blue in the face.
strings.所有人都要累一天、冻一天；以后多一张嘴: Everyone loses a day to exhaustion and cold; and one more mouth to feed afterwards
strings.所有人马上出去找：点上火把，分头喊: Everyone out at once: light torches, split up and shout
strings.手术成功了。小赵昏死过去，但呼吸慢慢平稳了下来。: The operation worked. Zack passed out cold, but his breathing slowly evened out.
strings.手机和充电宝轮流揣在几个人怀里，谁睡觉谁捂着。: The phone and the power bank pass from chest to chest; whoever is sleeping keeps them warm.
strings.手机屏幕黑了，再也按不亮。: The screen goes black and will not come on again.
strings.手机里还剩一点电。天放晴了，东面的山脊清清楚楚。{actor} 盯着它看了很久。: There is a little charge left in the phone. The sky has cleared and the east ridge stands out sharp against it. {actor} looks at it for a long time.
strings.手机里还剩一点电；山脊上的风口，还是那个风口: There is a little charge left in the phone; the wind on the ridge is the same wind
strings.扣下他的口粮和腰刀，等救援来了再还: Hold back his rations and his belt knife, and give them back when rescue comes
strings.找了快一个钟头，才在那一排人的尽头找到她。她蜷在妈妈身边，已经不怎么发抖了——这: It takes nearly an hour to find her at the end of the row. She is curled up beside her mother and has almost stopped shivering. That is the most frightening thing of all.
strings.承认：是我坚持继续飞的: Admit it: I was the one who insisted we fly on
strings.把 SOS 再摆大一倍，备好能烧的，飞机一往这边来就点黑烟: Make the SOS twice as big and stack everything that burns, ready to make black smoke the moment a plane turns this way
strings.把一捆钱塞给他：求他先把孩子背下去，路上用得着: Push a bundle on him: beg him to take the child down first. He may need it on the way
strings.把中毒的人拖到外面雪地里，吸新鲜空气: Drag the poisoned out into the snow for fresh air
strings.把剩下的抗生素都给他: Give him all the antibiotics that are left
strings.把剩下的燃料全点了，弄出黑烟: Burn all the remaining fuel, and make black smoke
strings.把大衣脱给他: Take off the coat and give it to him
strings.把头顶的氧气面罩一排排拉下来，轮流吸: Pull down the oxygen masks overhead, row by row, and take turns breathing
strings.把手从睡袋上拿开，翻个身接着睡: Take your hand off the sleeping bag, roll over and go back to sleep
strings.把本子放回他胸口，当没看见: Put the logbook back on his chest, and pretend you never saw it
strings.把衣服取下来给活人穿: Take the clothes and put them on the living
strings.把货舱里的货一箱箱搬出来翻找：吃的、能烧的。: Haul the cargo out of the hold, box by box, and search it: food, anything that burns.
strings.把这一页拿给大家看：这种时候写这个，本身就不对劲: Show everyone the page. Writing this, at a time like this, is wrong in itself
strings.把隔热棉缝进座椅套里，做一个能在野外过夜的睡袋。每次要用掉 1 块隔热棉。: Sew insulation into a seat cover to make a sleeping bag that can last a night out in the open. Costs 1 piece of insulation each time.
strings.把饼干还给豆豆，她还在长身体: Give the biscuit back to Dottie; she is still growing
strings.抓把雪使劲搓她的手和脚，老辈人都是这么治冻伤的: Rub her hands and feet hard with snow; that is how the old folks always treated frostbite
strings.抓紧最后的天光干点活: Use the last of the daylight to get something done
strings.抗生素只有这么一点: There is only this much antibiotics
strings.护主、机灵；饿极了也不抢吃的，只是一动不动地盯着看。: Loyal and quick; even starving he will not snatch food, he only stares, without moving.
strings.抱着她，给她唱歌: Hold her and sing to her
strings.抽出一捆钱塞进他的藏袍：五万，先背我下山: Push a bundle inside his robe: fifty thousand, carry me down first
strings.拆下来的木头货箱: Wooden crates stripped from the cargo
strings.拉萨……阿妈这辈子，还没见过大昭寺呢。: Lhasa... In all her life, Amala has never seen the Jokhang.
strings.拖到一半，脚下的雪板“咔”地裂开，整片往下滑。几个人被冲出去十几米，包裹只抢回来: Halfway back the slab cracks under them and the whole surface slides. Several of them are swept a dozen metres; only half the bundle is saved.
strings.拨了七八次，每次都是忙音，或者“您拨打的电话暂时无法接通”。: Seven or eight attempts: a busy tone every time, or a recorded voice saying the call cannot be connected.
strings.按市价打欠条：谁吃了谁签字，下山以后一分不少还她: Write IOUs at market price: whoever eats signs, and pays her back in full once we are down
strings.挨饿时身体先烧体脂，体脂越少，发抖产热的能力越弱——饥饿会让人更容易冻死。: When you starve, the body burns its fat first, and the less fat you have, the weaker your shivering heat; hunger makes the cold far more likely to kill you.
strings.换上从机尾找到的电池，重新接好天线。需要技术。: Fit the battery found in the tail and reconnect the antenna. Takes technical skill.
strings.接受他可能撑不过去: Accept that he may not last
strings.接过塑料袋，答应他一定带到: Take the bag, and promise him it will get there
strings.推搡中，周建国的伤臂撞在了座椅骨架上，他疼得蹲了下去。: In the shoving, George Zhou's broken arm smacks into a seat frame, and he crouches down, doubled over with pain.
strings.推选一个人背着睡袋翻过山脊求救。他要独自在雪山里走好几天。: Choose one person to carry the sleeping bag over the ridge for help. He will walk alone in the snow mountains for days.
strings.推选一个人，揣着小赵的手机爬上东面的山脊，去找那一格信号。: Choose someone to carry Zack's phone up the east ridge and find that one bar of signal.
strings.掰成小块，一人一块: Break it into pieces, one each
strings.搓了半天，豆豆的手指不但没缓过来，指尖上还起了一串紫黑色的水泡。懂医的人赶过来一: After all that rubbing Dottie's fingers are no better, and a row of purple-black blisters has come up on the tips. Whoever knows medicine takes one look and goes white: you never rub frostbite, least of all with snow. The ice grinds up the frozen flesh and chills the child even more.
strings.搜救概率 = 搜救力度 ×（基础 + 信号醒目程度）× 能见度；搜救力度每天衰减: Search probability = search effort x (base + how visible your signal is) x visibility; search effort decays every day and effectively stops around day 9. Fixing the locator beacon raises the odds of being found a great deal.
strings.撕破脸，但知道该防着谁: It turns ugly, but at least you know who to watch
strings.收起来，留到最要紧的时候: Put it away, and save it for when it really counts
strings.收音机里断断续续传来新闻：“……失联航班……搜救工作正在全力进行……”机舱里有人: The radio crackles out a bulletin: "...missing flight... search operations continuing at full effort..." Someone in the cabin starts to cry.
strings.放它走——狗认得路，也许能找到人: Let him go: a dog knows the way, and he might find someone
strings.救援直升机把活着的人带下了雪山：{survivors}。留在冰斗里的，还有 {d: The rescue helicopter took the living down off the mountain: {survivors}. Left behind in the cirque: {dead}. Years later, the survivors still will not talk about the choices they made in those days.
strings.明天推选一个人，揣着手机爬上东面山脊: Tomorrow, choose someone to carry the phone up the east ridge
strings.明天推选人选。走的人九死一生，但这可能是唯一的机会: Tomorrow they choose who goes. Whoever walks out has maybe one chance in ten, but it may be the only one they get
strings.是黄豆把他引上来的：那条瘦得只剩骨头的黄狗，在他帐篷外面叫了一整夜。: It was Bean that brought him up here: the yellow dog, thin down to the bone, barked outside his tent all night.
strings.晴天把雪铺在铝板上让太阳晒化；阴雪天只能烧燃料化雪（每次用掉半份燃料）；什么都没: On a clear day, spread snow on aluminium sheets and let the sun melt it; under cloud or snow you can only burn fuel (half a unit each time); with nothing at all, you warm a little snow with body heat.
strings.暴风雪把机身的断口吹开了，雪往里灌。必须有人出去把它重新堵上。推选一个人去。: The blizzard has torn the breach in the fuselage open, and snow is pouring in. Someone has to go out and seal it again. Choose one person to go.
strings.最后一个人被拉上舱门的时候，回头看了一眼那截半埋在雪里的机身。: As the last one is pulled up into the doorway, they look back at the fuselage, half buried in the snow.
strings.最强壮的几个人先上了飞机。留下的人看着他们，谁也没说话。: The strongest few board first. Those staying behind watch them, and nobody speaks.
strings.最醒目，但今晚可能就没火了（需要 2 份燃料）: The most visible of all, but there may be no fire tonight (costs 2 units of fuel)
strings.有人喝了雪水后上吐下泻。取雪的地方离遇难者和垃圾堆太近了。: Someone is vomiting and has diarrhoea after drinking snow water. The snow was taken too close to the dead and the rubbish.
strings.有人在雪地上插了一根木条，算是墓碑。: Someone plants a wooden stake in the snow, as a grave marker.
strings.有人小声说：他烧是烧，可他认得出这里的每一个人。: Someone says quietly: Fever or not, he knows every single person here.
strings.有人把他的牛皮口袋和腰刀拿了过去。泽仁没有争，只是把手里的念珠攥得紧紧的。: Someone takes his leather sack and his belt knife. Tsering does not argue; he only grips the prayer beads in his hand.
strings.有人爬上机舱顶，用刀和扳手在蒙皮上撬开一道缝。冷风灌进来，头疼慢慢轻了。: Someone climbs onto the cabin roof and works a gap in the skin with a knife and a wrench. Cold air pours in, and the headaches slowly ease.
strings.有人用刀在机身上刻下了一排名字。牧民们摘下帽子，低声念了一段经。: Someone carves a row of names into the fuselage. The herders take off their hats and murmur a prayer.
strings.有人用刀在机身上刻下了一排名字。螺旋桨卷起的雪很快把它们盖住了。: Someone carves a row of names into the fuselage. The snow churned up by the rotor blades covers them again in no time.
strings.有人看见领头人偷偷往马红梅手里塞吃的。: Someone saw the leader quietly pressing food into Helen Ma's hand.
strings.有人自己打开收音机，听到了重播的新闻：搜救几天前就停了。有人一直知道，却没说。: Someone turns the radio on and catches a repeat of the bulletin: the search was called off days ago. Someone knew all along, and said nothing.
strings.有钱能使鬼推磨——在这儿也一样吗？: Money makes the mare go. Does it, up here?
strings.机尾厨房里没动过的餐食: Untouched galley meals from the tail
strings.机组的人切开变形的面板，{actor} 被抬上了直升机。: The crew cut through the buckled panel, and {actor} is lifted aboard the helicopter.
strings.机组的人跳下来，把担架一副一副抬上了舱门。剩下的人在雪地里一直挥手，直到它消失在: The crew jump down and pass the stretchers up into the doorway one after another. Those left on the snow keep waving until the helicopter disappears behind the ridge.
strings.机腹底下的狗叫声，从昨天起就再也没有了。豆豆把耳朵贴在地板上，听了一整夜。: The barking from under the belly of the plane stopped yesterday, and has not come back. Dottie pressed her ear to the floor and listened all night.
strings.机腹底下隐约传来狗叫，隔着地板闷闷的，一声比一声哑。豆豆一下子扑到地板上：“是黄: A dog is barking somewhere under the floor, muffled, hoarser with every sound. Dottie throws herself down onto the floor: "It's Bean! Bean is still down there!" Her mother had crated the family dog and checked it into the hold.
strings.机舱和散落的行李: The cabin and the scattered luggage
strings.机舱外并排躺着遇难者的遗体，雪已经盖住了一半。他们身上还穿着厚实的外套和靴子。: Outside the cabin the dead lie in a row, already half covered by snow. They are still wearing heavy coats and boots.
strings.机舱里只有刀刮骨头的声音。{actor} 一声没吭，把皮带咬出了两排牙印。: The only sound in the cabin is the knife scraping bone. {actor} does not make a sound, and bites two rows of marks into the belt.
strings.机身还算完整，能挡风，但到了夜里，舱里的温度会掉到零下十几度。驾驶舱被压扁了，机: The fuselage is more or less intact and blocks the wind, but at night the temperature inside drops below -10°C. The cockpit is crushed; the captain is jammed in the buckled seat with both legs pinned under the instrument panel, and he is conscious. Of the nine who survived, three are badly hurt, there is a seven-year-old child, and a Tibetan grandmother who broke her hip and cannot walk.
strings.机长会难过；可往后，你不用再一个人背着它: The captain will be hurt; but from now on you will not carry it alone
strings.杀了它。人比狗要紧: Kill him. People matter more than dogs.
strings.杨卫东保住了命，左腿从膝盖以下截掉了。他在航空公司培训中心教了几年高原特情处置，: Victor Yang lived, minus his left leg below the knee. For a few years he taught plateau emergency handling at the airline's training centre; every time he reached the page on "turn back or push on", he would stop and take a sip of water.
strings.杨卫东截掉了左腿，再也没回过驾驶舱。调查组来病房取证，他一口咬定继续飞是机长的决: Victor Yang lost his left leg and never went back to a cockpit. When the investigators came to his hospital room for evidence, he insisted, flatly, that flying on had been the captain's decision. The day he was discharged he had Martin Chen push his wheelchair to the end of the runway, and watched take-offs and landings all afternoon.
strings.杨卫东是在冰斗的太阳底下走的。活下来的人说，他最后一句话是“能见度很好”。他女儿: Victor Yang died in the sunlight of the cirque. The survivors say his last words were "visibility's good". When his daughter received the plastic bag, tucked inside his licence was a photo of her, taken on the first day of her final year of school.
strings.杨卫东的飞行记录本被交给了调查组，最后一页只有一行歪歪扭扭的字：对不起，各位旅客: Victor Yang's flight log went to the investigators. The last page held one crooked line: I am sorry, ladies and gentlemen. That summer his daughter got into university. She studies meteorology.
strings.杨机长已经喝不下水了，嘴唇裂着口子。他把 {actor} 叫到跟前，摸索着从制服: The captain can no longer keep water down; his lips are split. He calls {actor} close and fumbles a plastic bag out of the inside pocket of his uniform: his licence, his wedding ring, and a few pages folded into a neat square. "Take this to my daughter." After a while he says: "And... let me see today's sky."
strings.杨机长没再说话，把塑料袋塞回了内兜。: The captain says nothing more, and puts the bag back in his pocket.
strings.杨机长看了 {actor} 很久，叹了口气：“……他还年轻。”就这一句，什么都说: The captain looks at {actor} for a long time, and sighs. "...He's young." That one line says everything.
strings.杨机长看着 {actor}，一字一顿：“是我的决定。”说完就闭上了眼睛。: The captain looks at {actor} and says each word separately: "It. Was. My decision." Then he closes his eyes.
strings.杨机长被卡在驾驶舱里已经两天两夜了，两条腿压在变形的仪表板下面，早就没了知觉。拿: The captain has been trapped in the cockpit for two days and two nights, both legs pinned under the buckled instrument panel, long since without feeling. A seat frame used as a lever will lift the panel; but the legs have been crushed too long, and the moment they are freed, the potassium and toxins in the dead muscle will flood into his blood, and his heart may stop on the spot.
strings.杨机长让人把陈默叫进驾驶舱，又要了纸和笔。他的声音很轻，一句是一句：“小陈，我的: The captain has Martin Chen called into the cockpit, and asks for paper and a pen. His voice is very quiet, every sentence like a reading off a gauge. "Martin, I know what my legs mean. Write two things for me. A letter to my daughter. And one page in the flight log: Continuing was the captain's decision. When it's written, I'll sign it." He looks at Martin Chen. "That's an order."
strings.林姐，你去歇会儿吧，我真没事。: Sister Lin, go and rest. I am really all right.
strings.林晓下山后第一件事，是坐了两个小时的公交车，把那个塑料袋交到了杨机长的女儿手里。: The first thing Sharon Lin did after coming down was ride a bus for two hours to put the plastic bag into the hands of the captain's daughter. The girl did not cry. She asked only: did it hurt, at the end? Sharon Lin said: no. It was the first time in all her years as a nurse that she had lied to a patient's family.
strings.林晓回急诊科上班的第一个夜班，接了一个冻伤的登山客，处理得又快又稳。每年春节，她: On her first night shift back in the emergency room, Sharon Lin took a mountaineer with frostbite and handled it fast and sure. Every Spring Festival two things arrive: a drawing of the snow mountains from Dottie, and a crate of dried yak beef from Zack.
strings.林晓把在雪山上做过的每一个判断都写了下来，写了很长，没给任何人看。她辞掉了成都的: Sharon Lin wrote down every judgement she had made on the mountain. It ran very long, and she showed it to no one. She quit her job in Chengdu and went back to the county hospital in Garze, and stayed three years there.
strings.林晓把巧克力掰成两半。豆豆舔着手指，看了一圈大人，小声说了句谢谢。: Sharon Lin breaks the chocolate in two. Dottie licks her fingers, looks round at the adults, and says thank you, very quietly.
strings.林晓把胶囊拆开，把药粉混在雪水里喂她喝了下去。: Sharon Lin opens the capsule and stirs the powder into snow water, and gets her to drink it.
strings.林晓把药一粒一粒喂进他嘴里。: Sharon Lin puts the pills into his mouth one at a time.
strings.林晓用座椅的铝骨架和布条做了夹板。: Sharon Lin makes a splint from an aluminium seat frame and strips of cloth.
strings.林晓的护士证和半卷没用完的纱布，被装进同一个塑料袋带下了山。急诊科的同事把她的工: Sharon Lin's nurse's licence and half a roll of unused gauze came down the mountain in the same plastic bag. Her colleagues in the emergency room hung her badge on the board by the nurses' station, and there it stayed, a very long time; nobody could bring themselves to take it down.
strings.林晓被赶出去的那天，只带走了自己的护士包。后来山下的牧场里有人说，一个汉族女护士: The day Sharon Lin was driven out she took only her nurse's bag. Later, down at the pastures, people said a Han nurse had delivered a herder's child in a tent. No one could be sure it was her.
strings.林阿姨，你不会走吧？: Auntie Lin, you won't leave, will you?
strings.核心体温逐小时计算：气温按昼夜曲线变化，叠加风寒、阳光、湿身、机身保温（随完好度: Core temperature is worked out hour by hour: air temperature follows a day-night curve, with wind chill, sun, wet clothing, the shelter's insulation (which falls as it degrades), the fire and bodies packed together all added on top. The lower a person's clothing insulation, the faster they lose heat.
strings.橙色的降落伞挂在坡上，被风吹得一鼓一鼓的。: The orange parachute hangs on the slope, filling and emptying in the wind.
strings.每个人分到指甲盖大的一小块，含在嘴里很久舍不得咽。: Everyone gets a piece the size of a fingernail, and holds it in their mouth a long time, unwilling to swallow.
strings.每个人都从自己那份里掰下一小块。机舱里有人笑了，这是几天来的第一次。: Everyone breaks off a little of their own share. Someone in the cabin laughs, for the first time in days.
strings.每个人都会暖和一些，但心里那道坎很难过: Everyone will be a little warmer, but getting past it in your own head is hard
strings.每个面罩只能出十几分钟氧气，还烫手；拉完就没了: Each mask gives only ten-odd minutes of oxygen, and burns your hand; when they are used up, that is it
strings.求他把豆豆背下山: Ask him to carry Dottie down the mountain
strings.汉话说得夹生，带康定口音，管自己叫“阿妈”，嘴里不停地念“嗡嘛呢叭咪吽”。: Her Chinese comes out halting, with a Kangding accent. She calls herself Amala, and never stops murmuring "Om mani padme hum".
strings.江杰受够了：“再等下去大家都得死在这！老子现在就翻过去求救！”他已经在收拾东西了: Jay Jiang has had enough: "Wait any longer and we all die here! I'm going over that ridge for help, right now!" He is already packing, and everyone knows what a night out there without a sleeping bag means.
strings.江杰回学校读完了大四。那件冲锋衣挂在宿舍门后，袖口上有个烧焦的洞，一直没补。毕业: Jay Jiang went back and finished his final year. The shell jacket hangs behind his dorm door, a scorched hole in the cuff, never mended. At graduation he turned down the outdoor club job and sat the exam for the meteorological bureau.
strings.江杰把杨机长托付的塑料袋送到了他女儿学校的门口。那天正好是高考放榜，他站在人群外: Jay Jiang took the captain's plastic bag to his daughter's school. It was the day the exam results came out. He stood at the edge of the crowd and watched the girl crouch on the ground clutching the bag, and waited until she stood up again.
strings.江杰是一个人走出雪山的，带走了全队唯一的睡袋和最后的口粮。他接受过很多采访，每次: Jay Jiang walked out of the snow mountains alone, taking the team's only sleeping bag and the last of the food. He gave a lot of interviews, and every time he got to that night he said he had gone for help. The people who lived through the cirque never took his calls again.
strings.江杰是那个走出雪山的人。在牧场上昏过去之前，他用冻黑的手指在雪地上画了一张图。后: Jay Jiang was the one who walked out. Before he passed out at the pasture he drew a map in the snow with fingers black with frostbite. Afterwards he trained in mountain rescue; the day he led his first team up, it was November.
strings.江杰没找到下山的路，拖着冻伤的脚爬了回来。: Jay Jiang found no way down. He dragged himself back, feet frostbitten.
strings.江杰的眉骨被撞开了一道口子，血流了半张脸。: Jay Jiang's brow is split open, blood down half his face.
strings.江杰的追悼会，周建国坐在最后一排，一坐就是一上午。在雪山上他们吵过、动过手。走的: At Jay Jiang's memorial, George Zhou sat in the back row for the whole morning. Up on the mountain they had argued and come to blows. Leaving, he pressed a thick envelope into Jay Jiang's mother's hand and said not a word.
strings.江杰的遗体是第二年六月在东面山脊下的一条冰裂缝里找到的，睡袋还捆在背上。他走的方: Jay Jiang's body was found the following June in a crevasse below the eastern ridge, the sleeping bag still strapped to his back. He had been walking the right way. Four kilometres further on, you can see the smoke from the pasture fires.
strings.江杰紧了紧鞋带，头也不回地走了。: Jay Jiang tightens his laces and walks off without looking back.
strings.江杰骂了一句，还是坐下来拿起了针线。: Jay Jiang swears, but sits down and picks up the needle anyway.
strings.沉稳、话少，习惯把责任揽到自己身上。清醒的时候最惦记乘客和他带出来的副驾驶；烧起: Steady, quiet, and used to taking the blame on himself. While he is lucid his mind is on the passengers and the first officer he brought up; when the fever rises he talks nonsense.
strings.沉默、克制、内疚；做事有条理；被逼急了会冷冷地反击。: Silent, restrained, eaten up with guilt; methodical; and when he is pushed too far he hits back, coldly.
strings.没事……我忍得住。: It's fine... I can take it.
strings.没人上去拉。两个人扭打在狭窄的过道里，撞翻了一锅刚化好的雪水。: Nobody steps in. The two of them wrestle in the narrow aisle and knock over a pot of freshly melted snow water.
strings.没人再提这件事。那天晚上，好几个人把自己那口吃的掰下一点，扔给了黄豆。: Nobody mentions it again. That night, several of them break off a little of their own food and toss it to Bean.
strings.没人再提这件事，但大家看彼此的眼神变了。: Nobody mentions it again, but the way people look at each other has changed.
strings.没人去挖。那一夜，狗叫声和豆豆的哭声搅在一起，谁也没睡着。: Nobody goes to dig. That night the barking and Dottie's crying run together, and no one sleeps.
strings.没人说话。每个人都多了一件外套。: Nobody speaks. Everyone has one more coat.
strings.没人说话。豆豆低着头，把手里的饼干渣舔干净了。: Nobody speaks. Dottie keeps her head down and licks the biscuit crumbs off her fingers.
strings.没有人知道陈默最后去了哪里。几个月后，他的飞行执照被寄回了航空公司，信封上没有寄: No one knows where Martin Chen went in the end. Months later his pilot's licence arrived back at the airline; no sender on the envelope, the postmark Kangding.
strings.没有网络，定位要在开阔处等上十几分钟才定得住；人在风口一动不动，冷得要命: With no network, a fix takes a good ten minutes in the open; standing still in that wind is brutally cold
strings.没那么严重，明天照样干活: It is not that bad; he can work just the same tomorrow
strings.泽仁后来被县里表彰，奖金他全拿去寺里点了灯。记者问他那天怕不怕，他想了很久，说：: The county later gave Tsering a commendation, and he took the whole award to the monastery and spent it on butter lamps. A reporter asked if he had been afraid that day. He thought about it for a long time, and said: Found two of the yaks.
strings.泽仁在前面踩出一串深深的脚印。: Tsering breaks a line of deep footprints ahead of them.
strings.泽仁在这里住了两夜，烧了几十锅雪水，还帮着把机身的断口重新垒了一遍。今天风小了，: Tsering has stayed two nights, boiled dozens of pots of snow water and helped rebuild the breach in the fuselage. The wind has dropped today, and he says he will cross the pass while the weather holds, to take word down. If anyone can walk, he can take one person with him.
strings.泽仁把剩下的糌粑留在机舱里，一个人朝垭口走去。: Tsering leaves the rest of the tsampa in the cabin and walks off towards the pass alone.
strings.泽仁把豆豆往上托了托，回头冲机舱笑了一下。: Tsering hitches Dottie higher on his back and looks back at the cabin with a smile.
strings.泽仁比划着说，后天就要翻垭口下山。夜里，马红梅摸着箱子里一捆一捆的钱，看着在火边: Tsering has made them understand that he will cross the pass and go down the day after tomorrow. At night Helen Ma runs her fingers over the bundles of money in her suitcase, watching Tsering doze by the fire. The injured, the very young. He can carry one person at a time.
strings.泽仁点点头，把牛皮口袋往机舱角落里一放，掏出一口熏黑的铜锅，出去铲雪了。: Tsering nods, drops his leather sack in the corner of the cabin, takes out a soot-blackened copper pot, and goes out to shovel snow.
strings.泽仁看了他们很久，什么也没说，转身走进了雪里。: Tsering looks at them for a long moment, says nothing, and turns away into the snow.
strings.泽仁紧了紧腰带，朝东面的垭口走去，很快就成了雪坡上的一个黑点。: Tsering tightens his belt and sets off for the eastern pass, soon no more than a dark speck on the slope.
strings.泽仁背着豆豆，朝东面的垭口走去。: Tsering carries Dottie on his back, heading for the eastern pass.
strings.泽仁说到做到。乡里的干部、几个牧民和县里的救援队跟着他翻过垭口，用牦牛把冰斗里的: Tsering did what he said he would. Township officials, a few herders and the county rescue team crossed the pass behind him, and yaks carried the people of the cirque down the mountain one by one. Those who left the cirque alive: {survivors}. Those who did not live to see the day: {dead}. That winter, new prayer flags went up in front of several tents on the pastures below.
strings.泽仁跟着大家一起下了山。他在县医院门口蹲了一夜，等最后一个伤员被推进手术室，才骑: Tsering came down the mountain with the rest of them. He crouched outside the county hospital all night, and only when the last of the wounded had been wheeled into surgery did he get on his motorbike and ride back to the pasture. Of the three stray yaks, two were found again when spring came.
strings.泽仁那天没能翻过垭口：雪太深，他在半山腰挖了个雪洞熬了一夜，冻掉了两根脚趾。等他: Tsering never crossed the pass that day: the snow was too deep, he dug a snow cave half way up and lasted the night in it, and lost two toes to frostbite. By the time he took the long way round to the township and raised the alarm, half a month had passed.
strings.泽仁醒了，摸到藏袍里那捆硬邦邦的东西，愣了一下。: Tsering wakes, feels the hard bundle inside his robe, and goes still.
strings.活着见到刚出生的外孙: Live to see his newborn grandson
strings.派一个人带着睡袋下山: Send one person down with the sleeping bag
strings.派身体最好的人跟他一起下山: Send the fittest of them down with him
strings.浓烟滚滚地升了起来。: Black smoke rolls up into the sky.
strings.海拔 4100 米，夜里零下 25 度。搜救随时可能停止。: 4,100 metres up, -25°C at night. The search could stop at any moment.
strings.海拔 4100 米：呼吸失水更多、热量消耗高 10%；重体力活会加重高原反应，严: At 4,100 m: you lose more water breathing and burn 10% more energy; heavy work makes altitude sickness worse, and in the worst case it becomes HACE.
strings.消息就只有你知道: The news stays with you alone
strings.清掉压在机身上的积雪，用行李和雪块堵住破口。: Clear the snow piled on the fuselage and plug the breach with luggage and blocks of snow.
strings.清掉驾驶舱风挡上的雪，让太阳照进来: Clear the snow off the cockpit windscreen and let the sun in
strings.清早，雪坡冻得梆硬，冰爪似的脚步一踩一个坑。包裹完完整整地拖了回来：四箱单兵口粮: At dawn the slope is frozen iron-hard and every kick leaves a clean step. The bundle comes back whole: four cases of field rations, a bale of army quilts, two first-aid kits, a box of cephalosporin, a few blocks of solid fuel, and a laminated note. Coordinates received. Helicopter waiting on a weather window. Hold on.
strings.清点物资的时候，箱底只剩最后一板巧克力，大概 500 千卡。所有人的眼睛都盯着它: Taking stock, there is one last bar of chocolate at the bottom of the crate, about 500 kcal. Every eye in the cabin is on it.
strings.火堆离油箱那头远一点……燃油味还没散干净。: Keep the fire away from the fuel tank end... the smell of fuel has not cleared yet.
strings.火把的光在雪地上乱晃。十几分钟后，有人在那一排人的尽头找到了她：她蜷在妈妈身边，: Torchlight lurches across the snow. A quarter of an hour later someone finds her at the end of the row, curled up against her mother, her own pink scarf laid over her mother's face.
strings.烧一壶热水灌进瓶子，裹上衣服，塞在她腋下和大腿根: Boil water, fill bottles, wrap them in clothes and tuck them in her armpits and groin
strings.烧掉箱子里的钱: Burn the cash in the case
strings.热水瓶隔着衣服塞在她的腋下和大腿根，那里血管粗，热得快。: The wrapped bottles go into her armpits and groin, where the big blood vessels are and the warmth gets in fastest.
strings.照他说的写，让他签字: Write it as he says, and let him sign
strings.熬一熬，今晚不生火了: Tough it out; no fire tonight
strings.燃料 +2，但机舱会更漏风: Fuel +2, but the cabin will leak more wind
strings.燃料快烧完了，今晚会冷到零下二十度。有人看向马红梅的箱子：里面的现金，一捆一捆都: The fuel is nearly gone, and tonight will drop to -20°C. Someone looks at Helen Ma's case: the cash inside, bundle after bundle, would burn.
strings.爬上东面的山脊，看清下山的路。很累，也很危险：冰裂缝、滑坠、高原反应。: Climb the eastern ridge and get a look at the way down. Exhausting and dangerous: crevasses, falls, altitude sickness.
strings.物资可能就找不回来了: The supplies may be lost for good
strings.物资抢回来了一部分。等大家回头去挖人的时候，有的人已经没有了呼吸。: Some of the supplies were saved. By the time they went back to dig for the people, some of them had stopped breathing.
strings.狗在下面能撑几天，谁也说不准: How many days a dog can last down there, nobody can say
strings.狗鼻子在雪地里比人眼快得多: A dog's nose is far quicker in the snow than human eyes
strings.狗鼻子比人手快；它自己也可能被砸着: A dog's nose is faster than human hands; but he could be crushed himself
strings.现在还没到最难的时候……吧: This is not the worst of it yet... probably
strings.用墨镜片和硬纸板做个护目镜: Make goggles from sunglasses lenses and cardboard
strings.用掉 1 份急救用品，能大大降低感染风险: Costs 1 unit of medical supplies, and cuts the risk of infection a great deal
strings.用掉 1 份燃料；热水瓶要隔着衣服，直接贴着皮肤会烫伤: Uses 1 unit of fuel; the bottles must be wrapped, against bare skin they burn
strings.用掉 1.5 升水，好得慢: Costs 1.5 L of water; he heals slowly
strings.用掉半升水: Costs half a litre of water
strings.用毯子把舷窗挡上，别让她再看了: Hang a blanket over the porthole so she cannot look any more
strings.用行李和座椅在雪地上摆出巨大的 SOS，把铝板擦亮朝向天空。下雪会把它们盖住。: Lay out a huge SOS in the snow with luggage and seats, and polish the aluminium sheets to face the sky. Snowfall will cover them.
strings.用行李箱、座椅和雪块把断口垒了起来。风小了很多。: They wall up the breach with suitcases, seats and blocks of snow. The wind drops a lot.
strings.用隔热棉和座椅布缝一个能在零下三十度露营的睡袋。没有它，下山的人撑不过第一夜。: Sew insulation and seat fabric into a sleeping bag that can camp at -30°C. Without it, whoever walks down will not last the first night.
strings.电话通了三秒：“喂？喂？你说哪里？……飞机？”{actor} 喊出了“冰斗”“还: The call connects for three seconds. "Hello? Hello? Where did you say? ...A plane?" {actor} shouts "cirque" and "still alive", and the line drops. Every redial fails.
strings.电话里能说清楚的事多得多；可通话要的信号比短信强得多，一格未必撑得住: You can explain far more on a call; but a call needs much more signal than a text, and one bar may not hold
strings.留在机舱里更安全，但食物撑不了多久: Staying in the cabin is safer, but the food will not last long
strings.留着那点电，等更好的天: Save the charge for a better day
strings.登山社在学校后山立了一块小石头，刻着江杰的名字，下面还有一行小字：他说要带大家走: The mountaineering club set a small stone on the hill behind the school, with Jay Jiang's name carved on it and a line underneath in smaller letters: He said he would get us all out. Every November, someone leaves a new pair of gloves at the stone.
strings.白天的太阳很毒，雪地反光刺得睁不开眼；一到晚上，冷得能把人冻透。食物只剩空乘餐车: The daytime sun is savage, and the glare off the snow is blinding; once night comes, the cold goes straight through you. All that is left to eat is a little of the crew's snack food from the galley cart. Outside, people know the flight is missing, but not where it came down.
strings.直升机往返了好几趟。最后一个人被拉上舱门的时候，回头看了一眼那截半埋在雪里的机身: The helicopter made several runs. As the last one was pulled up into the doorway, they looked back at the fuselage, half buried in the snow. {aliveCount} people, not one missing. The doctors said afterwards: it was not luck that kept you alive.
strings.直升机第一趟还剩几个座位（内部计数）。: How many seats are left on the helicopter's first run (internal count).
strings.直升机落下来的时候，跳下来的第一个救援队员手里攥着一张打印纸，上面是那条短信：坐: When the helicopter sets down, the first rescuer to jump out is holding a printed sheet of paper: the text message. Coordinates, how many, who is hurt. He says that once it reached headquarters, they never stood down a single aircraft again. Those who left the cirque alive: {survivors}. Those who did not live to see it: {dead}.
strings.省下急救用品，但效果差一些: Saves medical supplies, but works less well
strings.省着燃料，太远了看不见的: Save the fuel; it is too far away to be seen
strings.省着电，每天只听一次整点新闻: Save the battery: listen to the hourly news once a day
strings.眼不见，也许心就不想: Out of sight, out of mind, perhaps
strings.睡袋缝好了，下山的路也探得差不多了。江杰说：等下去是等死，必须有人翻过山脊去求救: The sleeping bag is sewn, and the way down is more or less scouted. Jay Jiang says: Waiting here is waiting to die. Someone has to cross the ridge for help.
strings.私下交给陈默: Give it to Martin Chen privately
strings.私下找他要一份: Ask him for a share, privately
strings.私藏的东西会被充公: What you stashed will be handed over
strings.秘密会被揭开，可你不用再一个人背着它: The secret comes out, but you no longer carry it alone
strings.租给他：明天他那份口粮归你: Rent it to him: tomorrow his ration is yours
strings.穿着一件貂皮大衣，随身拖着一只从不离手的铝合金箱子。能说会道，很会看人脸色。: Wears a mink coat and drags an aluminium case she never lets out of her hand. Smooth-tongued, and quick to read a face.
strings.穿着全队最好的冲锋衣和登山靴，自称爬过好几座雪山。年轻、体力好，一心想自己走出去: Wears the best shell jacket and boots in the group, and claims to have climbed several snow mountains. Young, strong, and set on walking out by himself.
strings.站到雪檐最外面，把手机举高，一有信号马上发: Stand at the far edge of the cornice, phone held high, and send the moment there is signal
strings.第一天你判断前排那个昏迷的男人没救了，先去救了别人。今天早上你才发现，他是昨夜才: On the first day you decided the unconscious man in the front row was beyond saving, and went to help someone else instead. This morning you found out he had only stopped breathing last night. He might have been saved.
