strings.第二天傍晚，面板终于撬开了。杨机长被抬进客舱，喝了一口热水，说了声谢谢。: The next evening the panel finally came up. The captain was carried into the passenger cabin, drank a mouthful of hot water, and said thank you.
strings.第二天早上，{actor} 和周建国谁也没提昨晚的事。: The next morning neither {actor} nor George Zhou mentions last night.
strings.第二天，江杰突然很笃定地说东边能下山。: The next day Jay Jiang announces, with sudden certainty, that the way down is to the east.
strings.第二年五月，转场的牧民在冰斗里发现了半埋在雪里的机身。机舱里的人挤在一起，像是睡: The following May, herders moving between pastures found the fuselage half buried in the cirque. Inside, the bodies were pressed together, as if asleep. No one knows what they said to each other in those last days.
strings.第二年开春，卓玛阿妈的儿子陪她去了拉萨。她在大昭寺门口磕了三天长头，用从雪山上带: The spring after, Amala Dolma's son took her to Lhasa. She bowed at the Jokhang for three days, and with the lump of butter brought down from the mountain she lit a row of lamps: one for each of the people who never came off the mountain.
strings.第六天傍晚，一个瘦得脱了相的人跌跌撞撞地走进了山脚下的牧场。第二天一早，救援直升: Towards evening on the sixth day, a figure thin to the bone stumbled into the pasture at the foot of the mountain. Early the next morning the rescue helicopter followed the route he had drawn, and found the cirque. Those who lived to be rescued: {survivors}.
strings.第六天，一个瘦得脱了相的人独自走进了山脚下的牧场，背上捆着全队唯一的睡袋。报出的: On the sixth day a man thin to the bone walked alone into the pasture below, the team's only sleeping bag on his back. The position he gave was exact; next morning the helicopter found the cirque. Rescued alive: {survivors}. Not: {dead}. The missing sleeping bag and the last of the food were never mentioned again: bring them up, and you could never sit at the same table.
strings.等出去了，我请大家吃牦牛肉火锅。管够。: When we get out, I'm treating everyone to yak hotpot. As much as you can eat.
strings.等别人来拉: Wait for someone to pull you out
strings.等定位刷新出来，再走到雪檐最外面去发: Wait for the fix, then walk out to the very edge of the cornice to send it
strings.等明天清早再去：坡上的雪夜里冻实了，最稳: Go at dawn tomorrow: the slope freezes hard overnight and is safest early
strings.等货舱挖开了再说: Wait until the hold is dug open
strings.算了，他也是想保住大家的希望: Never mind. He was trying to keep everyone's hope alive.
strings.箱子又合上了。那天夜里，好几个人都听见了马红梅嚼东西的声音。: The suitcase is closed again. That night, several of them hear Helen Ma chewing.
strings.精明、现实、怕死；擅长拉拢人、做交易；嘴上客气，心里只算自己的账。: Shrewd, practical, afraid of dying; good at winning people over and making deals; polite out loud, and keeping her own accounts in her head.
strings.糌粑用雪水拌开，一人分到一小团。卓玛阿妈把酥油重新包好，揣回了怀里。: The tsampa is mixed with snow water and everyone gets a small ball of it. Amala Dolma wraps the butter up again and tucks it back inside her robe.
strings.糌粑，吃！酥油茶，喝了，不冷。: Tsampa, eat! Butter tea, drink, not cold.
strings.紧急定位发射器的备用电池: Spare battery for the emergency locator transmitter
strings.给他一个盼头——还是不让他安心地交代后事？: Giving him hope, or refusing to let him put his affairs in order?
strings.给明天要去干重活的人: For whoever has heavy work tomorrow
strings.翻个身，当没看见：那是她自己的东西: Roll over and pretend you saw nothing. It is her own
strings.翻了半天，什么也没找到: An hour of digging, and nothing
strings.翻找残骸和行李: Search the wreck and the luggage
strings.老实、怕拖累别人。: Honest, and afraid of being a burden.
strings.背上睡袋，把箱底剩的吃的全揣上，一个人翻过山脊: Take the sleeping bag, pocket everything left at the bottom of the crate, and cross the ridge alone
strings.背着睡袋的人: The One With the Sleeping Bag
strings.能把准确位置告诉后面的人；被留下的人会记住这一刻: You can give the people behind you the exact position; and the ones left behind will remember this moment
strings.能换来好几晚的火（燃料 +4），马红梅会恨死投赞成票的人: Buys several nights of fire (fuel +4); Helen Ma will hate anyone who votes for it
strings.能烧的行李箱、纸箱、座椅海绵。一份大约能烧两个小时。: Suitcases, cardboard and seat foam that will burn. One unit burns for about two hours.
strings.脚下的雪檐“噗”的一声塌了。{actor} 跟着雪块滑下去十几米，被一块岩石卡住: The cornice gives way with a soft whump. {actor} slides a dozen metres with the snow before a rock stops {actor.him}; {actor.his} left leg is agony, and {actor.his} hand is still clamped around the phone.
strings.脚下的雪檐“噗”的一声塌了。{actor} 连人带雪一起坠下了背风的那一面，喊声: The cornice gives way with a soft whump. {actor} goes down the lee face with it, and the wind snatches the shout away.
strings.腿……我已经感觉不到我的腿了。也好，不疼了。: My legs... I cannot feel my legs any more. Just as well. It does not hurt.
strings.至少等睡袋缝好: At least wait until the sleeping bag is sewn
strings.舱门开了一刻钟又关上了。机舱里还是一股呛人的味道。: The door was open a quarter of an hour, and then shut again. The cabin still stinks, enough to choke you.
strings.舷窗挡上了。豆豆不哭也不闹，只是夜里一直睁着眼睛。: The porthole is covered. Dottie neither cries nor makes a fuss. At night she lies with her eyes open.
strings.藏起来，自己偷偷听: Hide it, and listen on your own
strings.虫草和雪水煮了一锅，满舱都是一股说不出的腥味。马红梅一口没喝，坐在箱子边上，把空: The fungus goes into a pot with snow water, and the cabin fills with an indescribable fishy smell. Helen Ma does not drink a mouthful; she sits by the suitcase folding the empty boxes flat, one by one.
strings.螺旋桨的声音又响了。直升机回来了，这一趟，舱里给剩下的人都留了位置。: The rotors start up again. The helicopter is back, and this time there are seats aboard for everyone left.
strings.螺旋桨的声音由远及近——一架橙色的救援直升机在冰斗上空盘旋，然后压低了高度！高原: The sound of rotors comes closer: an orange rescue helicopter circles over the cirque, then drops altitude! The air is thin up here; it can take three people at most on one run, and the rest must wait for the next. Who goes first?
strings.被压住超过一天的腿一旦松开，坏死肌肉里的钾和肌红蛋白会一下子涌进血液，人可能当场: Once a leg has been pinned for more than a day, the moment it is released the potassium and myoglobin from the dead muscle flood into the blood, and the heart can stop on the spot (crush syndrome); drink plenty of water first, and the risk is much smaller. Lighting a fire in a cabin sealed too tight leads to carbon monoxide poisoning.
strings.被赶出机舱的那天夜里，周建国一个人朝山脊走去。第二年五月，转场的牧民在垭口下面找: The night George Zhou was driven out of the cabin, he walked off alone towards the ridge. The following May, herders moving between pastures found him below the pass, a photograph of his grandson in his coat, its corners worn soft with handling.
strings.要是……要是我拖累大家了，你们就走，别管我。: If... if I am holding everyone back, then go. Leave me.
strings.要用掉 3 升水和一点吃的；松开时出事的可能小得多: Costs 3 L of water and a little food; the odds of something going wrong when you release him are much smaller
strings.让他一个人走，走得快: Let him go alone; he travels faster
strings.让他们打，打完就消停了: Let them fight; when it is over they will settle down
strings.让他去探路，自己少出头: Let him scout, and keep your own head down
strings.让他把豆豆背下去: Get him to carry Dottie down
strings.让大家看清她是什么人: Let everyone see what she really is
strings.让她睡在火边，多分她一点吃的: Give her a place by the fire and a little more food
strings.让她还有个盼头: Leave her something to hope for
strings.让小赵和豆豆都活着离开雪山: Get Zack and Dottie off the mountain alive
strings.让拿主意的人决定怎么说: Let whoever is in charge decide how to say it
strings.让最壮的那个人去找，其他人别再出去冻着: Let the strongest go and look; nobody else goes out to freeze
strings.让黄豆去嗅雪里埋着的人和东西: Send Bean to sniff out the people and supplies buried in the snow
strings.让黄豆去找，两个人跟着它: Send Bean to find her, with two people following
strings.证明自己：亲自走出雪山，或者让所有人都活下来: Prove himself: walk out of the snow mountains himself, or keep every one of them alive
strings.说了就得解释坠机前的航线: Say it, and you will have to explain the route before the crash
strings.说出你坚持继续飞的事: Tell them you insisted on flying on
strings.说妈妈去找救援了: Tell her Mama has gone to get help
strings.说是突然遇到了强气流: Say they hit sudden severe turbulence
strings.说机长烧糊涂了，在说别的航班: Say the captain is delirious, talking about another flight
strings.说话圆滑，爱叫人“妹妹”“兄弟”，开口就许好处。: Smooth talk, all "little sister" and "brother", promising favours the moment she opens her mouth.
strings.说话简短，用词专业，尽量不谈坠机的事。: Short sentences, professional words, and he keeps off the subject of the crash as much as he can.
strings.说话轻，但很干脆，习惯用医生的口吻下判断。: Speaks softly but bluntly, and gives her verdicts in a doctor's voice.
strings.请他留两天，帮着烧水、看天，等天好了再走: Ask him to stay two days, to help boil water and watch the weather, and go when it clears
strings.请他马上下山，去乡里报信: Ask him to go down now, and take word to the township
strings.谁也不用冒险；可一个七岁的孩子，在外面熬不了几个钟头: Nobody takes a risk; but a seven-year-old cannot last many hours out there
strings.谁走谁留，让大家定: Let everyone decide who goes and who stays
strings.谁都需要一点盼头；可在零下二十度里开着屏幕，电掉得飞快: Everyone needs something to hold on to; but a screen left on at minus twenty drains the battery fast
strings.调查组到病房取证那天，杨卫东说，继续飞是机长的决定。陈默站在走廊里，一直没敢进去: On the day the investigators came to the ward for evidence, Victor Yang said that flying on had been the captain's decision. Martin Chen stood out in the corridor and never dared go in. Afterwards he visited Victor Yang every year; the two of them could sit for an afternoon and never once mention that day.
strings.调查组在杨卫东胸口找到了那本飞行记录本。有一页写着：继续飞，是机长的决定。签名歪: The investigators found the flight log on Victor Yang's chest. One page said: Continuing was the captain's decision. The signature was a shaky scrawl, the witness Martin Chen. The report accepted that page. His daughter went to university the following year, to study meteorology.
strings.豆豆、小赵、机长这些最弱的先上，三个座位坐满为止；其他人再熬一阵: Dottie, Zack and the captain go first, the weakest of them, until the three seats are full; the rest hold on a while longer
strings.豆豆一整天都趴在舷窗边，看外面那一排盖着雪的人。她问大人们：“哪个是我妈妈？她冷: All day Dottie kneels at the porthole, looking at the row of snow-covered people outside. She asks the grown-ups: "Which one is my mum? Is she cold? Can I give her my scarf?"
strings.豆豆不会原谅投这一票的人: Dottie will never forgive anyone who votes for it
strings.豆豆后来记得的雪山上的事不多。她记得自己给妈妈围上了围巾，记得妈妈的脸很凉，记得: Dottie does not remember much about the mountain. She remembers putting her scarf round her mother, and how cold her mother's face was, and a grown-up holding her hand the whole time. She says she knew that day her mother would not wake up. "But I said goodbye to her."
strings.豆豆夜里咳得厉害，额头滚烫，呼吸里带着哨音。林晓说像是肺炎。: Dottie coughs badly in the night, her forehead is burning, and there is a whistle in her breathing. Sharon Lin says it looks like pneumonia.
strings.豆豆家养了四年的土狗，黄毛，一只耳朵立着一只耷拉着。豆豆妈妈舍不得把它留在康定，: The family dog, four years old, yellow-haired, one ear up and one ear down. Dottie's mother could not bear to leave him in Kangding, so she crated him and checked him into the hold. The hold is under the belly of the plane.
strings.豆豆抱着黄豆的脖子哭了很久，最后是她自己松开了手。: Dottie holds Bean round the neck and cries for a long time, and in the end it is she who lets go.
strings.豆豆抽抽搭搭地不肯走。泽仁蹲下来，用藏话哼了一段调子，她才趴到了他背上。: Dottie sobs and refuses to go. Tsering crouches down and hums a tune in Tibetan, and only then does she climb onto his back.
strings.豆豆拽着 {actor} 的袖子，小声问：“妈妈去哪儿了？她什么时候回来？”: Dottie tugs at {actor}'s sleeve and asks quietly: "Where did Mama go? When is she coming back?"
strings.豆豆没有哭，只是把脸埋进了 {actor} 的怀里，很久很久。: Dottie does not cry. She only buries her face against {actor} and stays there a long, long time.
strings.豆豆点点头。从那以后，每次分到吃的，她都要省下一小口，说是留给妈妈醒了吃。: Dottie nods. From then on, every time she is given food, she saves one small bite. For when Mum wakes up, she says.
strings.豆豆点点头，说那她要乖乖的等妈妈。: Dottie nods, and says she will be good and wait for Mama.
strings.豆豆的十个手指头都保住了。她说她记得一件很暖很暖的袍子，有一股酥油和烟火的味道，: Dottie kept all ten fingers. She says she remembers a robe that was very, very warm, smelling of butter and woodsmoke, and a voice that never stopped praying. When she grew up she went to the Tagong grasslands and asked from tent to tent after an old woman called Dolma.
strings.豆豆的爸爸从成都赶到医院，抱着她哭了很久。二年级的作文《我的妈妈》她写了三页，最: Dottie's father came from Chengdu to the hospital and held her and cried for a long time. For the second-grade essay "My Mother" she wrote three pages, and the last paragraph was about a nurse called Sharon Lin. Every Spring Festival, Sharon Lin receives a drawing of the snow mountains from her.
strings.豆豆缩在大人怀里，牙齿磕得咯咯响。磕了大半夜，才慢慢停下来，睡着了。: Dottie huddles against an adult's chest, her teeth chattering. It goes on for most of the night before it slowly stops and she falls asleep.
strings.豆豆被抱回机舱时浑身冰凉，嘴唇发紫，话也说不利索。手指头白得像蜡，摸上去硬邦邦的: When Dottie is carried back into the cabin she is ice-cold, her lips blue, her words slurred. Her fingers are white as wax and hard to the touch.
strings.豆豆被救援队抱下山的时候，身上还裹着好几件大人的衣服。她爸爸把那件粉色的羽绒服留: When the rescue team carried Dottie down the mountain she was still wrapped in several adults' coats. Her father kept the pink down jacket; it still hangs behind the door of her room.
strings.豆豆被裹进泽仁的藏袍里，只露出一张小脸。: Dottie is wrapped up inside Tsering's robe, with only her small face showing.
strings.豆豆被裹进泽仁的藏袍里，只露出一张小脸，朝机舱挥了挥手。: Dottie is wrapped up inside Tsering's robe with only her small face showing, and she waves at the cabin.
strings.豆豆趴在地板上，一下一下地敲，跟下面的黄豆说话。: Dottie lies on the floor, knocking, knock by knock, talking to Bean underneath.
strings.豆豆跟着爸爸去了成都，读完了小学。雪山上的事她记不太清了，只记得很冷，记得有人一: Dottie went to Chengdu with her father and finished primary school. She does not remember much about the mountain; she remembers being cold, and that someone held her the whole time. She is afraid of the dark, and still sleeps with a small lamp on.
strings.货舱最里面有一只托运的狗笼。笼子里的黄狗已经冻硬了，头还朝着笼门。: At the back of the hold is a dog crate. The yellow dog inside is frozen stiff, his head still turned towards the crate door.
strings.货舱最里面有一只托运的狗笼，一条黄狗缩在里面，瘦得脱了相，见了人还在摇尾巴。是豆: At the back of the hold is a dog crate, with a yellow dog curled inside, thin to the bone, still wagging his tail at the sight of people. It is Bean, Dottie's dog.
strings.货舱门压在机腹下面，要先挖开冻硬的积雪，再把变形的舱门撬开。很费力气。: The hold door is pinned under the belly of the plane, so first you dig through frozen snow, then force the buckled door. It takes hard labour.
strings.货舱门被压在机腹下面，埋在雪里。挖开它，也许能找到托运的货物。: The hold door is pinned under the belly of the plane, buried in snow. Dig it open, and there may be checked cargo inside.
strings.货舱门被撬开了：一箱箱从康定托运的糌粑、酥油和牦牛肉干。有人跪在雪地里笑出了声。: The hold door is forced open: crate after crate of tsampa, butter and dried yak beef, checked through from Kangding. Someone kneels in the snow and laughs out loud.
strings.贴身捂热是野外最稳当的复温办法；可阿妈自己的热量也会被吸走: Skin-to-skin is the safest way to rewarm someone in the field; but it draws the old woman's own heat away
strings.贴身捂热最稳当，不用火也不用药；抱着她的人，自己要冷上一夜: Skin-to-skin is the safest way, needing neither fire nor medicine; whoever holds her will be cold all night
strings.费点工夫，但能保护眼睛: Takes some work, but it protects your eyes
strings.走之前，把遇难者的名字刻在机身上: Before leaving, carve the names of the dead into the fuselage
strings.趁天亮，几个人用安全带连成一串，马上去把它拖回来: While it is light, rope a few people together with seat belts and drag it back now
strings.趁机长清醒，当面问他: Ask the captain himself, while he is lucid
strings.趁雪还没把东西埋住: Before the snow buries it all
strings.身体好的先走，给救援队带路: The fittest go first, to guide the rescue team in
strings.车上还有二十几个件没送呢，客户该打电话骂人了。: There are still twenty-odd parcels on the van. The customers are going to phone up and swear at me.
strings.转圈、举高、蹲下……短信一直显示“发送中”，最后变成了一个红色的感叹号。: Turning, holding it high, crouching... The message says Sending for a long time, then turns into a red exclamation mark.
strings.轮到 {actor} 守着收音机。整点新闻里，播音员说：“……因连日恶劣天气，失: It is {actor}'s turn to watch the radio. On the hour the announcer says: "...owing to days of severe weather, the search for the missing flight has been suspended..."
strings.这两天，飞机的嗡嗡声多了起来：西边很远的地方，一架接一架，来回地飞，一次也没往这: For two days there have been more planes: far off to the west, one after another, back and forth, never once coming this way. People out there know someone is still alive up here. They do not know where "here" is. Someone remembers that the phone has been offline for days, and the blue dot on its map has been sitting on Kangding airport all along.
strings.这个山，夏天，我的牛，在这里。: This mountain, summer, my yaks, here.
strings.这件事又被搁下了。江杰一个人在外面坐了很久。: It is shelved again. Jay Jiang sits outside alone for a long time.
strings.这件事暂时没有下文。: For now, nothing more comes of it.
strings.这是老人家自己的心意，随她吧: It is the old woman's own offering. Let her.
strings.远处传来飞机的嗡嗡声！一个小黑点在山谷另一边的上空慢慢移动。: A drone of engines in the distance! A small dark speck moves slowly across the sky on the far side of the valley.
strings.连孩子都知道分: Even a child knows what that means
strings.追问到底是谁瞒着: Press him on who kept it quiet
strings.退到迎风面的岩石后面，等定位刷新出来，再发一条短信：坐标、人数、伤员: Back off behind the rocks on the windward side, wait for a fresh GPS fix, then send one text: coordinates, how many, who is hurt
strings.那一夜，所有人挤在一起发抖，谁也没睡着。: That night everyone huddled together shivering, and nobody slept.
strings.那一夜，谁都没怎么睡，一会儿就有人爬起来看看西边那面坡。: Nobody sleeps much that night; every so often someone gets up to look at the west slope.
strings.那一斤半虫草，被大家拿雪水煮着吃了。马红梅后来又做起了虫草生意，只是每年都会留下: The three quarters of a kilo of caterpillar fungus were boiled up with snow water and eaten. Helen Ma went back into the fungus trade, but every year she keeps back the best box and will not sell it at any price. Asked what it is for, she says: for saving a life.
strings.那一页在机舱里传了一圈。陈默一直盯着自己的手。: The page goes round the cabin. Martin Chen keeps his eyes on his own hands.
strings.那二十八万在雪山上烧成了灰。马红梅从头做起，在成都一个菜市场租了个摊位卖干货。熟: The two hundred and eighty thousand went up in smoke on the mountain. Helen Ma started again from nothing, renting a stall in a Chengdu market to sell dried goods. When regulars haggle, she always says: Money burns and you earn it again. You only get one life. Then she laughs first.
strings.那坨供佛的酥油，在雪山上被大家吃掉了。卓玛阿妈说佛不会怪，人活着才能磕头。第二年: The butter meant for the Buddha was eaten by everyone on the mountain. Amala Dolma said the Buddha would not mind; you have to be alive to bow. The next year she went to Lhasa all the same, and begged a spoonful of butter at the Jokhang gate, and lit one small lamp.
strings.那天傍晚，机舱外的雪地上多了一摊血。夜里锅里第一次飘出了肉香，豆豆缩在角落里，一: That evening there was a pool of blood on the snow outside the cabin. That night the pot smelled of meat for the first time, and Dottie huddled in the corner and did not eat a bite.
strings.那是一个快死的人自己的意思: It is what a dying man wants
strings.那是她的东西，谁也不许动: It is hers. Nobody touches it.
strings.那是所有人这辈子最漫长的一个小时。: It was the longest hour of any of their lives.
strings.那里信号最好，越快越好；可手机好几天没联网，地图上的位置还是起飞前的: The best signal is there, and the sooner the better; but the phone has been offline for days, and the location on its map is from before take-off
strings.那面坡被太阳晒了一下午，雪是软的；包裹里也许有药和吃的: That slope has been in the sun all afternoon and the snow is soft; the bundle may hold medicine and food
strings.那面坡随时会塌，犯不着；可直升机什么时候能来，谁也说不准: That slope could go at any moment, it is not worth it; but no one knows when the helicopter can come
strings.都吃了吧，菩萨不会跟饿肚子的人计较: Eat it, all of it. The Buddha will not hold it against hungry people.
strings.钞票在火里卷曲、变黑，火苗蹿得很高。马红梅缩在角落里，一整晚没有说话。: The notes curl and blacken in the fire, and the flames leap high. Helen Ma huddles in the corner and does not speak all night.
strings.钱在这儿买不来命——也许能买来一个人路上的一口吃的: Money cannot buy a life up here; it might buy someone a meal on the way down
strings.锂电池怕冷，捂在怀里能多留些电；可外面的人不会一直找下去: Lithium batteries hate the cold, and kept warm they hold their charge; but the people out there will not search for ever
strings.锅里的雪水咕嘟咕嘟地翻滚着。: The snow water bubbles and rolls in the pot.
strings.阳光被雪面反射得刺眼，在外面干活的人眼睛开始刺痛、流泪。: The sun off the snow is blinding, and the eyes of those working outside begin to sting and water.
strings.阿妈的腿不中用了，手还行。针线，拿来。: Amala's legs are finished, but the hands still work. Needle and thread. Bring them.
strings.陈默一个人走出了雪山，带走了睡袋和最后的口粮。他报出的坐标分毫不差。事故调查报告: Martin Chen walked out of the snow mountains alone, taking the sleeping bag and the last of the food. The coordinates he gave were exact. In the accident report, that part is one sentence: the first officer went down alone to seek help.
strings.陈默一笔一画地写完了。杨机长签名的手抖得厉害，最后一笔拖出去老长。: Martin Chen writes it out, stroke by stroke. The captain's hand shakes so badly as he signs that the last stroke trails off across the page.
strings.陈默会恨你；可大家有权知道: Martin Chen will hate you; but everyone has the right to know
strings.陈默低着头，说了很久。说完以后，没有一个人看他。: Martin Chen keeps his head down and talks for a long time. When he finishes, not one person is looking at him.
strings.陈默写了很久。杨机长看完，没有签字，把本子合上，放在胸口：“……你这个娃娃。”: Martin Chen writes for a long time. The captain reads it, does not sign, closes the logbook and lays it on his chest. "...You stubborn kid."
strings.陈默在调查组面前把那天的事又说了一遍，一个字都没改。他被吊销了执照，后来在一所航: Martin Chen told the investigators the whole story again, and did not change a word. He lost his licence, and later taught ground school at a flying school; the first lesson of every term was the same thing: when to turn around.
strings.陈默在雪地上画出了山脊和那条小路的位置。: Martin Chen draws the ridge and the line of the track in the snow.
strings.陈默在黑暗里坐了很久，开口的时候，声音是哑的。: Martin Chen sits in the dark for a long time, and when he finally speaks his voice is hoarse.
strings.陈默把航图塞给了江杰，低声说了几句。: Martin Chen pushes the chart at Jay Jiang and says a few words, low.
strings.陈默把航图折好，塞回了制服内兜。: Martin Chen folds the chart away and tucks it back into the inside pocket of his uniform.
strings.陈默把那个塑料袋交给了杨机长的女儿，在她家门口站着，把雪山上的每一天都讲了一遍。: Martin Chen gave the plastic bag to the captain's daughter and stood at her door telling her about every day on the mountain. At the end the girl asked: so who was it that wanted to fly on? Martin Chen said: it was me.
strings.陈默摸黑走到机长身边，握住了他的手。机长不喊了，只是一遍一遍地念着一个航路点的名: Martin Chen feels his way through the dark to the captain and takes his hand. The captain stops shouting, and only repeats the name of a waypoint, over and over.
strings.陈默犹豫了很久，点了点头。马红梅把大衣递了过去。: Martin Chen hesitates for a long time, then nods. Helen Ma holds out the coat.
strings.陈默的秘密会被揭开: Martin Chen's secret will come out
strings.陈默的遗体被抬下山的时候，制服内兜里还装着那张折得整整齐齐的航图，上面用铅笔画了: When Martin Chen's body was carried down the mountain, the chart was still in the inside pocket of his uniform, folded neat, with a pencil line drawn on it from the cirque all the way to the pasture in the east.
strings.陈默站起来，走到机舱另一头坐下了。: Martin Chen stands up, and goes to sit at the other end of the cabin.
strings.雪一直在下，信号标志很快会被盖住。: The snow keeps falling, and the signal markers will be covered over quickly.
strings.雪地上的 SOS 一直摆到了冰斗口，每个字母都有三层楼那么长。: The SOS on the snow now reaches all the way to the mouth of the cirque, each letter three storeys long.
strings.雪地上的 SOS、反光板和烟火。下雪会盖住它们。: An SOS in the snow, reflective panels and smoke. Snowfall covers them.
strings.雪山是神山，不害人。是我们走到它跟前来了。: The snow mountain is a holy mountain. It means no harm. We are the ones who came and stood in front of it.
strings.雪崩多发生在被太阳晒软的下午；可今夜要是下雪，包裹就埋了: Slides mostly come in the afternoon, when the sun has softened the snow; but if it snows tonight the bundle will be buried
strings.雪檐坍塌，坠下山脊: Fell from the ridge when a cornice collapsed
strings.雪，明天，大。（指了指天）: Snow, tomorrow, big. (He points at the sky.)
strings.雷达最后一个点在贡嘎北边。他们会先沿着航路找，信号要摆大。: Radar's last plot was north of Gongga. They will search along the route first. Make the signal big.
strings.面板撬开了。杨机长被抬进客舱的时候，脸白得像纸，但还在喘气。: The panel is up. When the captain is carried into the passenger cabin his face is white as paper, but he is still breathing.
strings.风从贡嘎那边过来了。明天，要下大雪。: The wind is coming from Gongga. Tomorrow, heavy snow.
strings.风挡上的雪一块块扒掉，阳光照进了驾驶舱。杨机长眯着眼看了很久，说：“能见度很好。: The snow comes off the windscreen in slabs, and sunlight falls into the cockpit. The captain squints at it for a long time. "Visibility's good. You could fly today."
strings.风裹着雪砸在机身上，出门几步就看不见人。: Wind drives snow against the fuselage; step outside, and after a few paces you cannot see anyone.
strings.飞机在空中转了一个弯，摇了摇机翼——他们看见了！: The plane banks in the air and rocks its wings: they have seen us!
strings.飞机的声音一直在西边，像一只够不着的苍蝇。: The sound of the planes stays in the west, like a fly just out of reach.
strings.飞机的声音渐渐听不见了。有人把头埋进了膝盖里。: The sound of the plane fades away. Someone puts their head down on their knees.
strings.飞机突然掉头飞了过来——他们看见了！: The plane suddenly turns and comes back towards them: they have seen us!
strings.食物 +1300 千卡左右；她会记着这份情: About +1,300 kcal of food; she will remember the kindness
strings.食物 +2400 千卡左右；老人家会很难过: About +2,400 kcal of food; the old woman will be very hurt
strings.食物 +4500 千卡左右；豆豆会恨你们一辈子: About +4,500 kcal of food; Dottie will hate you for the rest of her life
strings.食物再 +1500 千卡；被这样对待的人，还会不会替你们跑这一趟？: Another +1,500 kcal of food; and will a man treated like that still make that trip for you?
strings.餐车里的饼干、坚果、巧克力和几瓶饮料，按热量计。: Biscuits, nuts, chocolate and a few bottles of drink from the galley cart, counted by calories.
strings.饿着的人化不了雪、挖不开货舱: Starving people cannot melt snow or dig out the hold
strings.马上打开听新闻: Turn it on now and listen to the news
strings.马上撬开，把他抬进客舱: Pry it open now and carry him into the passenger cabin
strings.马红梅下山后，拿着那本按满手印的记账本，挨家挨户去要账。有人当天就把钱转了过来，: After she came down, Helen Ma took the account book full of thumbprints from door to door to collect. Some paid the same day; some begged in tears for a few more months. A year later she locked the book in a drawer and never opened it again. The money was settled, she said; what she owed and was owed was not.
strings.马红梅亲手把杨机长的塑料袋交给了他女儿，又往孩子手里塞了一个信封。女孩没收，她就: Helen Ma handed the captain's plastic bag to his daughter in person, and pressed an envelope into the girl's hand as well. The girl would not take it, so Helen Ma endowed a scholarship at the university's meteorology department, in the name of "the people on the mountain".
strings.马红梅从包里翻出记账本，一笔一笔地写：几根、几克、多少钱，让每个人按了手印，这才: Helen Ma takes an account book out of her bag and writes it all down: how many, how many grams, how much money. Only when everyone has put a thumbprint on it does she open the boxes, one by one.
strings.马红梅会记恨你: Helen Ma will hold it against you
strings.马红梅悄悄塞给 {actor} 一张字条：“帮个忙，多分我一份吃的。出去以后我给: Helen Ma slips {actor} a note: "Do me a favour, give me an extra share of food. When we get out, I'll give you 200,000."
strings.马红梅把大衣披在陈默身上，自己裹了两条座椅套。“记住了啊，妹子我是做生意的，这笔: Helen Ma puts the coat round Martin Chen's shoulders and wraps herself in two seat covers. "Remember this now. I'm a businesswoman, little sister. This one goes on the tab."
strings.马红梅把大衣裹得更紧了一些。: Helen Ma pulls the coat tighter around herself.
strings.马红梅提着那只铝合金箱子出了院，钱和虫草一样没少。她再也没坐过飞机，去哪儿都坐大: Helen Ma walked out of the hospital with the aluminium case, not a note or a gram of caterpillar fungus short. She never flew again; wherever she went she took the bus, even if it meant ten hours more of jolting. What the case had held, she never told a soul, to the day she died.
strings.马红梅是一个人走出雪山的。后来她给冰斗里每一户遇难者家里都送去一个厚信封，一家一: Helen Ma walked out of the snow mountains alone. Afterwards she took a thick envelope to every family in the cirque who had lost someone, going door to door, and not one of them opened the door to let her in.
strings.马红梅没能下山。她那件貂皮大衣后来在机舱里被找到，裹在别人身上。没有人说得清，那: Helen Ma did not come down. Her mink coat was found later in the cabin, wrapped around someone else. No one could say whether she had taken it off herself before she went, or whether it had been stripped off her.
strings.马红梅的手一直在抖。她说这是她这辈子做过的最亏的一笔买卖。: Helen Ma's hands do not stop shaking. She says it is the worst deal she has ever made.
strings.马红梅的箱子当着大家的面打开了：上面一层是捆好的现金，底下码着十几个小纸盒，一盒: Helen Ma's suitcase is opened in front of everyone: a layer of banded cash on top, and beneath it a dozen little cardboard boxes, every one full of caterpillar fungus, three quarters of a kilo or so. "First-grade from Nagqu! Over two hundred thousand a kilo!" Her voice is shaking. Someone says coldly: "Two hundred thousand? Up here it's three quarters of a kilo of something to chew."
strings.马红梅的铝合金箱子被救援队登记、封存，交给了她在康定读初中的儿子。孩子打开看了一: Helen Ma's aluminium case was logged and sealed by the rescue team, and given to her son, in middle school in Kangding. The boy opened it, looked once, and closed it again. It stayed under his bed after that.
strings.马红梅瞪了 {actor} 一眼，还是抓了一把塞过来。: Helen Ma glares at {actor}, but pushes a handful across anyway.
strings.马红梅醒了，正好看见 {actor} 蹲在她的箱子旁边。: Helen Ma wakes, and sees {actor} crouched beside her case.
strings.驾驶舱冷得像冰窖，他在里面熬不了几天；可现在松开，他可能当场就没了: The cockpit is as cold as an icehouse, and he cannot last many days in there; but release him now, and he may go on the spot
strings.驾驶舱里的紧急定位发射器摔坏了，换上电池、接好天线，也许能向卫星发出信号。: The emergency locator transmitter in the cockpit was smashed in the crash. With a new battery and the antenna reconnected, it might send a signal to a satellite.
strings.高原反应又上来了，头疼得像要裂开，有人一直在吐。: The altitude sickness is back: heads splitting, and someone cannot stop vomiting.
strings.黄豆一出舱门就冲着那一排人跑了过去，在一个雪堆前又刨又叫。豆豆蜷在妈妈身边，黄豆: Bean is out of the door and racing for the row of the dead, digging and barking at one mound of snow. Dottie is curled up beside her mother; Bean burrows straight into her arms.
strings.黄豆下山以后，被豆豆的爸爸接去了成都，住进一个没有院子的小区。它冻掉了两个趾甲，: After they came down, Bean was taken to Chengdu by Dottie's father, into a flat with no yard. He lost two toenails to frostbite and walks with a limp. Snow is rare in Chengdu, and every time it falls he lies on the windowsill barking at the world for half an hour.
strings.黄豆在雪坡上回头看了一眼，朝东面的垭口跑去。: Bean looks back once on the snow slope, and runs for the eastern pass.
strings.黄豆在雪堆上来回地嗅，刨几下就叫一声。人顺着它刨的地方往下挖，一个一个把人拖了出: Bean sniffs back and forth over the snowdrifts, digs a little, and barks. They dig where he digs, and pull the people out one by one.
strings.黄豆没能下山。那只空狗笼后来被救援队带了下来，豆豆的爸爸一直没舍得扔，放在阳台上: Bean did not come down. The rescue team brought the empty crate down later; Dottie's father could never bring himself to throw it out, and kept it on the balcony with one of Dottie's baby blankets inside.
strings.黄豆跑下雪坡以后，就再没回来。山那边的一个牧民后来说，那几天夜里，总有一条黄狗在: Bean ran down the snow slope and never came back. A herder on the far side of the mountain said afterwards that for several nights a yellow dog had been barking outside his tent. The next summer someone saw him out on the pasture, running with a herd of yaks, and he would not turn his head when called.
strings.黄豆跟在他们后面，跑下了雪坡。: Bean follows them down the snow slope.
strings.黄豆那天夜里在雪堆里找到了豆豆，这件事被豆豆写进了作文，又被老师贴在了教室后面。: That night Bean found Dottie in the snow, and Dottie wrote it into a school essay that her teacher pinned up at the back of the classroom. Bean lost two claws to the frost and walks with a slight limp. Dottie says they are his medals.
strings.黑烟升起来了，可那个小黑点没有转向，慢慢消失了。: The black smoke goes up, but the small dark speck does not turn. It slowly disappears.
strings.（在雪地里刨了半天，叼回来一只不知道是谁的手套）: (After a long spell of digging in the snow, he comes back with someone's glove in his mouth.)
strings.（夜里挤进人堆，毛上的冰碴慢慢化成了水）: (At night he squeezes into the huddle, and the ice in his fur slowly melts to water.)
strings.（把下巴搁在豆豆的膝盖上，呜呜地哼了两声）: (He rests his chin on Dottie's knee and whines, twice.)
strings.（把那捆钱掏出来，放回箱子上，摇了摇头）钱，不要。孩子，先。: (takes the bundle out and puts it back on the suitcase, shaking his head) Money, no. Child, first.
strings.（把钱推回来，又被推回去，最后只抽了一张）路上，吃饭。剩下的，不要。: (pushes the money back, has it pushed back at him, and in the end takes a single note) On the way, food. The rest, no.
strings.（盯着别人手里的饼干，一动不动，口水滴在雪上）: (He stares at the biscuit in someone's hand, perfectly still, drooling onto the snow.)
strings.（竖起耳朵，冲东面的垭口叫了一声，又安静下来）: (His ears go up. He barks once at the eastern pass, and goes quiet again.)
strings.（趴在铝板边上，舔着刚化开的雪水）: (He lies by the aluminium sheet, lapping at the freshly melted snow water.)
